It's a lot of fun and I learned many Kanji this way! The runners will have to be careful since the stroke detection can be quite harsh on certain strokes and it's not allowed to use the "ignore mistake"-button!

categories.description: The original friendslop (probably, idk of any co-op games before this one). This is possibly the worst submission ever. A tower-defense style spinoff featuring that iconic Ratchet weaponry, 2012 internet humour, and some crazy unique skips, I guarantee you haven't seen an speedgame quite like this before.

The run builds momentum as abilities unlock, leading to faster gameplay and explosive boss fights. Rarely seen at marathons, it offers a fresh yet familiar Mega Man experience. There will also be a possibility showcase the modded character Awakened Zero as an incentive for even more action.

My PB as two deaths, but I promise I will improve it before ESA :')

6 players, 3 teams, 12 or 15 short (<3 min) NES games back to back! After each game is complete, we swap player and start the next game.

This category is the most popular by alot in this game, this category is filled with slick movement and a cool Infinite Jump. You will see us Boost Jump, IJ into some really cool catches and beating levels within 1:30 min

We'll be catching around half of the monkeys in the game in order to beat it.
categories.name: Any%

This is what it sounds like. You get every monkey in the game to unlock the true ending of the game. We got some cool monkey routing to set ourselves up for optimal revisits, Some really cool catches

o[8(|)

games.description:
Ape Escape is a classic Sony title which got released in the late PS1 Era. It uses unique controls where you have to use both analogs play, R1 to jump, face buttons to change gadgets.

You are a 10 year old tasked with saving the world, The Monkey specter got a hold of a Peak Point Helmet where he becomes super smart and evil, he sends him and his monkeys back in time to rewrite history
Its up to you to go back in time to capture all the apes and save the world

o[8(|)
games.name: Ape Escape

categories.description: Major Glitches are not allowed. Those would include a death glitch and OoB glitches, other smaller glitches will be used in the run, it is more about creative sequence breaks.
categories.name: any% No Major Glitches

games.description: Ultima 8 is a DOS-RPG from 1994 and was not very popular with Ultima fans, probably because it is a bit lighter on the RPG elements and instead has (kinda janky) platforming. The speedrun is almost a pacifist run and does a lot of stuff out of order or skips it completely with cool tricks like using blankets to cross a lava river and abusing the magic spells available.
games.name: Ultima VIII: Pagan

categories.description: Unlike the No OoB category that I ran last year, this run will be completely glitchless, this includes the use of the Respawn key which is also banned. 100% means collecting all 20 trinkets in the game.
categories.name: 100% Glitchless

games.description: VVVVVV is a very fast paced retro style precision platformer with the twist that instead of jumping you reverse the gravity of your character Viridian. It features a small open map that lets you choose levels in different orders. Each of the levels basically has a different gimmick that defines the stage, the final stage then combines them all. Also a great 8bit soundtrack.
games.name: VVVVVV

categories.description: Nightmare mode has a completely different final stage and final boss compared to the other categories and also starts you with 3 characters instead of one which leads to a lot of unique strats, especially the first three stages have a lot of additional zips that would not be possible otherwise.
categories.name: any% Nightmare/Veteran

games.description: Curse of the Moon is a retro-style game from 2018, heavily inspired by classic Castlevania games, basically a spiritual successor to Castlevania 3 with great retro style graphics and an amazing soundtrack. It has been at ESA before but never Nightmare mode. The run involves a lot of Zips to skip parts of the stages and cool boss quick kills.
games.name: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon

categories.description: standard any% category on the US version, everything is allowed
categories.name: any%

games.description: Kid icarus is a classic NES platformer from 1987. The player controls pit on his quest to gain three sacred treasures and save Angel Land from Medusa. The game features pretty challenging vertical and side scrolling platforming and maze-like boss stages. The speedrun uses wall clips to skip huge parts of the mazes (and one of the bosses) and manipulates certain enemies and platforms for faster patterns. There are also screen wraps involving playing stages basically without seeing ahead
games.name: Kid Icarus

categories.description: standard any% category, everything is allowed
categories.name: any%

games.description: Darkwing Duck is another great Disney/Capcom platformer from the NES era. The run is quite technical with the use of special weapons for platforming and quick boss kills and relies quite a bit on ammo drops which leads to some adaption on the fly.
games.name: Darkwing Duck

categories.description:
This category was practically made for live events.
Using the games built in job replay feature, you revisit every mission containing a boss fight, with the added benefit of upgrades you wouldn't have in a normal run. This is all the most exciting parts of the game, condensed into one tight package.
categories.name: All Bosses

categories.description: A run of the entire game featuring lots of glitches, skips and sick tech help go as fast as possible. Aside from that the run also requires lots of decision making as you constantly need to adapt to the amount of coins you're given from random looting, changing what gadgets(upgrades) you can afford.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
The fourth installment in the iconic Sly Cooper series and one of my favorite speed games.
The ancient book containing all the Cooper family's secrets and techniques is slowly being wiped away in the present, meaning the gang must go back in time to confront whoever is wiping out Sly's family legacy before his very eyes. 
The game is a flashy fast paced 3D platformer with lot of unique tech that differentiates it from its ps2 era counterparts. Game language will be English
games.name: Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time

categories.description:
A speedrun of the games forth episode.
Arguably the hardest single episode in the whole series, at top level. Requiring several difficult skips and heavy use of the infamous "push boost" tech, leading to mindblowingly fast movement and tech you'd never see playing casually.
categories.name: Episode 4

categories.description:
A multi episode run, mirroring the one I did earlier this year, at Winter 2026.
Going from the streets of Venice to the Australian outback, we will be rebuilding friendships, fighting ancient spirits, stopping an opera singer turned mafia boss, getting in bar fights and much more.
categories.name: Episode 1+2

games.description:
Sly 3 is my main speed game and a big passion of mine.
It's an iconic PS2 era 3D platformer with a lot of cool movement tech across multiple playable characters, a pleasant, vibrant art style and funny dialogue.
Game language will be English. A component cable will entirely prevent the technical difficulties we ran into, last time I ran this game at the event haha
games.name: Sly 3: Honor among Thieves

categories.description:
4 Separate Randomised seeds of each game will be put into an Archipelago multiworld each seed currently estimated to be around 5:30. 
The video link is off the first run of this seed, this is before a wind waker settings change and also whilst we are rusty. Video is for proof of concept.
categories.name: 4 Man Multiworld.

games.description:
4 Player Co-operate Zelda Archipelago. A Link To The Past. Ocarina Of Time. Wind Waker. Twilight Princess
Tompa - A Link To The Past
MajestikMelville - Ocarina Of Time
Whitefire - Wind Waker
Chrisoofy - Twilight Princess

Commentary - DynamicMelville and LosvikeN
games.name: 4 Player Zelda Randomiser (Archipelago)

categories.description: 100% Lite is a category extension where you beat the game as fast as possible; playing all worlds, fortresses, overworld map hammer bros, plant stages, and hand stages. Autscrolling stages are skipped in each world (except W8); and whistles are allowed to skip certain end-level air ships.
categories.name: 100% Lite

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible without using warps. All mushrooms, fireflowers, super leaves, and special suits are NOT allowed except for stars (which keep you in small Mario state). A challenging, dangerous category but also fun!
categories.name: Any% Warpless (Small Mario Only)

games.description: After his foray into Subcon, Mario finds himself in familiar territory. Koopas, goombas, spinies, piranha plants are back along with some new faces in this "return-to-form" Mario title! New to the game also is the overworld map of 8 new worlds; loaded with fortresses, hammer bros, and numbered stages. The end of each world you meet Bowser's "Koopa Kids"; each bringing their own twist with various abilities to thwart Mario on his quest through the Mushroom Kingdom.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. 3

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible. In-level warps are allowed. All major glitches (jumprolls, super jumprolls, super free rolls, split-up glitches, map and in-level wrong warps) are not allowed. The movement of DKC flows nicely; and is also quite a challenging speedrun.
categories.name: No Major Glitches

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible, playing every stage. Map warps, jumprolls, super jumprolls, super free rolls and split-up glitches are featured in this run. Most of these have small frame-windows to pull off. Tough category to run, but fun to watch when all the tricks are hit.
categories.name: All Stages

games.description: Donkey Kong has his own platforming adventure! Along with his pal Diddy Kong; Donkey moves, jumps, and rolls through jungles, forests, snow-covered mountains, gritty factories, and underground mines; encountering the Kremlings along the way in his quest to defeat King K. Rool and reclaim their beloved banana hoard!
games.name: Donkey Kong Country

categories.description: Just beat the game, skipping huge chunks of the game and going OOB.
categories.name: any%

games.description: System Shock 2 is cult-classic immersive sim that was truly ahead of its time combining RPG progression, horror elements and FPS. The run is being done on a NewDark version of the game and features massive (although somewhat difficult) sequence breaks allowing us to finish what casually would be ~12h long game in 14-17min. There is slightly element of RNG as well related to item duplication.
games.name: System Shock 2

categories.description: Beat the game while abusing all possible glitches and scrolling that mousewheel like crazy.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Hellforces is an obscure Russian shooter from 2005 that me and Drunkenshoe routed in 2017. It is likely to crash, it's it has atrocious movement, plenty of glitches and some absurd writing that make the protagonist look like he's schizophrenic. In the run we abuse the hell of a mousewheel and "permanent small state". Running the game requires using a custom framerate cap to shorten load times and make the game consistent. Essentially a garbage game for Hek or garbage block.
games.name: Hellforces

categories.description: It's any% - but it allows for modifying config files, so it's kinda cheating, but not really.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Immersive sim that defined pretty much everything afterwords. As usually, really hard run when it's easy to make a mistake. Not much has changed since the last time it was shown, but it's also been a while since it was at ESA. Mostly submitting this, because System Shock 2 got accepted to SGDQ :-/
games.name: Deus Ex

categories.description: All Stages Any%, we will be doing some zips and glitches, nothing that beats stages without killing the bosses though. The difference here will be each team will only have 1 controller on 2 people so as they say, sharing is caring!
categories.name: Any% 2p1c (2 players 1 controller)

games.description: Fleke+Niss3 vs Dxtr+Cartina in an Epic showdown, we will race, 2 players on one controller for each team. One person controlling Dpad + Select and other person doing Start + A + B.
games.name: Megaman 1 Coop Race

categories.description: Any% PRKD is the current world record route in SM.  This category is full of hard tricks and even the tiniest mistakes can put you in a bad spot or outright end your run. Full of sick sequence breaks, tricky bossfights and butt clenching moments; this category is sure to be an entertaining watch.
categories.name: Any% PRKD

games.description: Super Metroid is as classic as it gets among speedgames and I think everyone who has dipped their toes in retro gaming speedruns is at least aware of the legacy of this game. I believe most speedrunners would agree that no marathon would be complete without some kind of Super Metroid showcase. I have personally been running this game for about 5 years now and I still can not get enough of its movement, boss fights, variety in categories and the endless potential to improve.
games.name: Super Metroid

Its up to you to go back in time to capture all the apes and save the world

o[8(|)
games.name: Ape Escape

categories.description: Major Glitches are not allowed. Those would include a death glitch and OoB glitches, other smaller glitches will be used in the run, it is more about creative sequence breaks.
categories.name: any% No Major Glitches

games.description: Ultima 8 is a DOS-RPG from 1994 and was not very popular with Ultima fans, probably because it is a bit lighter on the RPG elements and instead has (kinda janky) platforming. The speedrun is almost a pacifist run and does a lot of stuff out of order or skips it completely with cool tricks like using blankets to cross a lava river and abusing the magic spells available.
games.name: Ultima VIII: Pagan

categories.description: Unlike the No OoB category that I ran last year, this run will be completely glitchless, this includes the use of the Respawn key which is also banned. 100% means collecting all 20 trinkets in the game.
categories.name: 100% Glitchless

games.description: VVVVVV is a very fast paced retro style precision platformer with the twist that instead of jumping you reverse the gravity of your character Viridian. It features a small open map that lets you choose levels in different orders. Each of the levels basically has a different gimmick that defines the stage, the final stage then combines them all. Also a great 8bit soundtrack.
games.name: VVVVVV

categories.description: Nightmare mode has a completely different final stage and final boss compared to the other categories and also starts you with 3 characters instead of one which leads to a lot of unique strats, especially the first three stages have a lot of additional zips that would not be possible otherwise.
categories.name: any% Nightmare/Veteran

games.description: Curse of the Moon is a retro-style game from 2018, heavily inspired by classic Castlevania games, basically a spiritual successor to Castlevania 3 with great retro style graphics and an amazing soundtrack. It has been at ESA before but never Nightmare mode. The run involves a lot of Zips to skip parts of the stages and cool boss quick kills.
games.name: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon

categories.description: standard any% category on the US version, everything is allowed
categories.name: any%

games.description: Kid icarus is a classic NES platformer from 1987. The player controls pit on his quest to gain three sacred treasures and save Angel Land from Medusa. The game features pretty challenging vertical and side scrolling platforming and maze-like boss stages. The speedrun uses wall clips to skip huge parts of the mazes (and one of the bosses) and manipulates certain enemies and platforms for faster patterns. There are also screen wraps involving playing stages basically without seeing ahead
games.name: Kid Icarus

categories.description: standard any% category, everything is allowed
categories.name: any%

games.description: Darkwing Duck is another great Disney/Capcom platformer from the NES era. The run is quite technical with the use of special weapons for platforming and quick boss kills and relies quite a bit on ammo drops which leads to some adaption on the fly.
games.name: Darkwing Duck

categories.description:
This category was practically made for live events.
Using the games built in job replay feature, you revisit every mission containing a boss fight, with the added benefit of upgrades you wouldn't have in a normal run. This is all the most exciting parts of the game, condensed into one tight package.
categories.name: All Bosses

categories.description: A run of the entire game featuring lots of glitches, skips and sick tech help go as fast as possible. Aside from that the run also requires lots of decision making as you constantly need to adapt to the amount of coins you're given from random looting, changing what gadgets(upgrades) you can afford.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
The fourth installment in the iconic Sly Cooper series and one of my favorite speed games.
The ancient book containing all the Cooper family's secrets and techniques is slowly being wiped away in the present, meaning the gang must go back in time to confront whoever is wiping out Sly's family legacy before his very eyes. 
The game is a flashy fast paced 3D platformer with lot of unique tech that differentiates it from its ps2 era counterparts. Game language will be English
games.name: Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time

categories.description:
A speedrun of the games forth episode.
Arguably the hardest single episode in the whole series, at top level. Requiring several difficult skips and heavy use of the infamous "push boost" tech, leading to mindblowingly fast movement and tech you'd never see playing casually.
categories.name: Episode 4

categories.description:
A multi episode run, mirroring the one I did earlier this year, at Winter 2026.
Going from the streets of Venice to the Australian outback, we will be rebuilding friendships, fighting ancient spirits, stopping an opera singer turned mafia boss, getting in bar fights and much more.
categories.name: Episode 1+2

games.description:
Sly 3 is my main speed game and a big passion of mine.
It's an iconic PS2 era 3D platformer with a lot of cool movement tech across multiple playable characters, a pleasant, vibrant art style and funny dialogue.
Game language will be English. A component cable will entirely prevent the technical difficulties we ran into, last time I ran this game at the event haha
games.name: Sly 3: Honor among Thieves

categories.description:
4 Separate Randomised seeds of each game will be put into an Archipelago multiworld each seed currently estimated to be around 5:30. 
The video link is off the first run of this seed, this is before a wind waker settings change and also whilst we are rusty. Video is for proof of concept.
categories.name: 4 Man Multiworld.

games.description:
4 Player Co-operate Zelda Archipelago. A Link To The Past. Ocarina Of Time. Wind Waker. Twilight Princess
Tompa - A Link To The Past
MajestikMelville - Ocarina Of Time
Whitefire - Wind Waker
Chrisoofy - Twilight Princess

Commentary - DynamicMelville and LosvikeN
games.name: 4 Player Zelda Randomiser (Archipelago)

categories.description: 100% Lite is a category extension where you beat the game as fast as possible; playing all worlds, fortresses, overworld map hammer bros, plant stages, and hand stages. Autscrolling stages are skipped in each world (except W8); and whistles are allowed to skip certain end-level air ships.
categories.name: 100% Lite

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible without using warps. All mushrooms, fireflowers, super leaves, and special suits are NOT allowed except for stars (which keep you in small Mario state). A challenging, dangerous category but also fun!
categories.name: Any% Warpless (Small Mario Only)

games.description: After his foray into Subcon, Mario finds himself in familiar territory. Koopas, goombas, spinies, piranha plants are back along with some new faces in this "return-to-form" Mario title! New to the game also is the overworld map of 8 new worlds; loaded with fortresses, hammer bros, and numbered stages. The end of each world you meet Bowser's "Koopa Kids"; each bringing their own twist with various abilities to thwart Mario on his quest through the Mushroom Kingdom.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. 3

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible. In-level warps are allowed. All major glitches (jumprolls, super jumprolls, super free rolls, split-up glitches, map and in-level wrong warps) are not allowed. The movement of DKC flows nicely; and is also quite a challenging speedrun.
categories.name: No Major Glitches

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible, playing every stage. Map warps, jumprolls, super jumprolls, super free rolls and split-up glitches are featured in this run. Most of these have small frame-windows to pull off. Tough category to run, but fun to watch when all the tricks are hit.
categories.name: All Stages

games.description: Donkey Kong has his own platforming adventure! Along with his pal Diddy Kong; Donkey moves, jumps, and rolls through jungles, forests, snow-covered mountains, gritty factories, and underground mines; encountering the Kremlings along the way in his quest to defeat King K. Rool and reclaim their beloved banana hoard!
games.name: Donkey Kong Country

categories.description: Just beat the game, skipping huge chunks of the game and going OOB.
categories.name: any%

games.description: System Shock 2 is cult-classic immersive sim that was truly ahead of its time combining RPG progression, horror elements and FPS. The run is being done on a NewDark version of the game and features massive (although somewhat difficult) sequence breaks allowing us to finish what casually would be ~12h long game in 14-17min. There is slightly element of RNG as well related to item duplication.
games.name: System Shock 2

categories.description: Beat the game while abusing all possible glitches and scrolling that mousewheel like crazy.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Hellforces is an obscure Russian shooter from 2005 that me and Drunkenshoe routed in 2017. It is likely to crash, it's it has atrocious movement, plenty of glitches and some absurd writing that make the protagonist look like he's schizophrenic. In the run we abuse the hell of a mousewheel and "permanent small state". Running the game requires using a custom framerate cap to shorten load times and make the game consistent. Essentially a garbage game for Hek or garbage block.
games.name: Hellforces

categories.description: It's any% - but it allows for modifying config files, so it's kinda cheating, but not really.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Immersive sim that defined pretty much everything afterwords. As usually, really hard run when it's easy to make a mistake. Not much has changed since the last time it was shown, but it's also been a while since it was at ESA. Mostly submitting this, because System Shock 2 got accepted to SGDQ :-/
games.name: Deus Ex

categories.description: All Stages Any%, we will be doing some zips and glitches, nothing that beats stages without killing the bosses though. The difference here will be each team will only have 1 controller on 2 people so as they say, sharing is caring!
categories.name: Any% 2p1c (2 players 1 controller)

games.description: Fleke+Niss3 vs Dxtr+Cartina in an Epic showdown, we will race, 2 players on one controller for each team. One person controlling Dpad + Select and other person doing Start + A + B.
games.name: Megaman 1 Coop Race

categories.description: Any% PRKD is the current world record route in SM.  This category is full of hard tricks and even the tiniest mistakes can put you in a bad spot or outright end your run. Full of sick sequence breaks, tricky bossfights and butt clenching moments; this category is sure to be an entertaining watch.
categories.name: Any% PRKD

games.description: Super Metroid is as classic as it gets among speedgames and I think everyone who has dipped their toes in retro gaming speedruns is at least aware of the legacy of this game. I believe most speedrunners would agree that no marathon would be complete without some kind of Super Metroid showcase. I have personally been running this game for about 5 years now and I still can not get enough of its movement, boss fights, variety in categories and the endless potential to improve.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: Bid war for which misc category with alternative ending I will showcase (Meteor Police, Talk show, Talk show twist, Rockstar or Photographer)
categories.name: Miscellaneous

games.description: Maniac Mansion is interesting in the way that it has multiple endings. Generally we only use the fastest one in speedruns so you never get to see the alternative endings in speedruns.
games.name: Maniac Mansion

categories.description: Beat the game without using any warp cannons, in the process clearing all eight main worlds and achieving pure greatness with both the propeller and penguin suits!
categories.name: Cannonless

games.description:
New Super Mario Bros. Wii is the second instalment in the New Super Mario Bros. Series and probably the best one! This game not only introduces the propeller and penguin suits which compliments runs really well, but also its revolutionary co-op multiplayer, much like LittleBigPlanet!

LittleBigPlanet 2 is very similar and came out around the same period (just over a year apart!) and it would be HUGE to see both games together at a marathon some day. Maybe ESA could be the first to do it? 🤔
games.name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii

categories.description:
Beat the game while clearing all eight castles! This is a particularly great category because you get to see lots more of the game not covered in Any%, and a perfect balance between too short and too long.

You will see lots of flying squirrel suit and a bit of penguin suit action in this run!
categories.name: All Castles (Normal)

games.description: This is the fifth and final instalment in the New Super Mario Bros. Series and Luigi is the star of the show! He comes with his own iconic physics giving him floaty high jumps and longer slides, which allows us to do tricks Mario normally can't. You also have another character in the fold, Nabbit the porpol thieving rabbit, he's invincible to most enemies so useful in stages with lots of enemies and can grab the flagpole faster as well.
games.name: New Super Luigi U

categories.description: A difficult run, but I will practice a lot and hopefully make it look easy :)
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Really cool indie metroidvania that not too many people know about featuring a diverse range of movement tech and action packed boss fights.
games.name: Rebel Transmute

categories.description: I wanted to submit a longer category, but didn't get it routed in time for the submission :p
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Going back to my bread and butter, the beautiful janky mess that is Ultima 9. It was my first speedrun and the one I have put the most time into. I recently broke the 40 min barrier in any%, so I thought now would be a good time to bring the game back to ESA.
games.name: Ultima IX: Ascension

categories.description: Tune up glitch with lux is prohibited in this category
categories.name: No tune-up glitch RTA

games.description: Impossible game Impossible game bad idea bad idea. Hardest rpg on the snes by far and infamous among gamers from all eras. Willing to sacrifice my soul and sanity to show off this rng hell-hole that has a lot of uniqueness about it.
games.name: The 7th saga

categories.description: Out of bound glitches and getting to the wedding asap
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Take a lovely stroll through ye olde England streets and towns as Dr. Jekyll slowly tries to make his way to his wedding. On his way he will be attacked by bird poop, dogs, cats, gravediggers, slingshot boys, random bomb setting men, villagers and nearly everything in existence. If Jekyll is hit too much he turns into Mr Hyde who has to fire the PSYCHO WAVE to defeat brains and other ghouls to become Jekyll again.
games.name: Dr. Jekyll and Mr Hyde

categories.description: A run of every track in Mario Kart 8 Deluxe! 200cc is fast paced and demanding of player skill, dodging items on very tight lines. High technical driving skills with itemless shortcuts abound make for an excitingly close race where anyone can win! A true celebration of this franchise's history.
categories.name: 96 Track 200cc (Items)

categories.description: A run of every track in Mario Kart 8 Deluxe! 200cc is fast paced and demanding of player skill, dodging items on very tight lines. High technical driving skills with itemless shortcuts make for a fast paced speedrun where the tracks fly by! Offered as alternative to race or relay.
categories.name: 96 Track 200cc (Items)

categories.description: A run of every track in Mario Kart 8 Deluxe! 200cc is fast paced and demanding of player skill, dodging items on very tight lines. High technical driving skills with itemless shortcuts make for a fast paced speedrun where the tracks fly by! Offered as alternative to race or solo run.
categories.name: 96 Track 200cc (Items)

games.description: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe released in 2017 and is an enhanced version of the original game from 2014. It is a kart racing game where you aim for first place, and in a speedrun, are trying to complete each track as quickly as possible. High driving skills and ability to react to items and predict how the game will slow the player down are crucial to going fast. Technical knowledge is utilised for itemless shortcuts and racing lines to save as much time as possible.
games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe

categories.description:
Unlike Any%, this category showcases the full game. It’s seen as the most “casual” main category since we collect every key and progress somewhat normally but this run is anything but casual, using insane tricks, proxies, and OOB movement.
My PB is 58:45. 2nd personal ESA WR incoming?  (⌐■‿■)
categories.name: All Keys

games.description: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus is one of the classic platforming games on the PlayStation 2, and is one of the big three PS2 mascots, standing next to Ratchet and Jak. The game introduces a stealth mechanic, which was rarely seen in games at the time. The game is a beloved classic, cherished by fans around the world. The speedrun of the game is ridiculously broken, we use as many glitches as possible to go out of bounds, or make Sly go flying.
games.name: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Racconus

categories.description: A run through the games main story, covers the Saiyan Saga to the Cell Saga.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The first game in the Budokai series.
games.name: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai

categories.description: A run through the game on NG+, this allows us to carry over some party members for a more optimal setup.
categories.name: NG+ Beginner Any%

games.description: The HD version of the 3DS Kingdom Hearts game.
games.name: Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD

categories.description: Street Boyz!
categories.name: NG+ All Stages

games.description: Street Boyz!
games.name: Street Boyz

categories.name: Any%

games.description: A game that covers what happened to Kiryu after the events of Yakuza 6.
games.name: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name

categories.description: A race between Rebel and Murtag to try and flip 10 coins onto heads the fastest.
categories.name: Any% Glitchless

games.description: A game about sheer will, grit and determination as you try and flip 10 heads in a row.
games.name: Unfair Flips

categories.description: A run through the games side story Dark Ties.
categories.name: Dark Ties Any%

games.description: The remake of Yakuza 3 with a little more added in.
games.name: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties

categories.description: A run through the game on Critical mode, this is run at level 1 as that is the fastest way to play Critical.
categories.name: Aqua Critical Level 1 Any%

games.description: The HD version of the PSP Kingdom Hearts game.
games.name: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix HD

categories.description: A run through the games arcade mode.
categories.name: Arcade Mode (Sleepwalker)

games.description: The 3rd version of the highly regarded fighting game.
games.name: Skullgirls 2nd Encore

categories.description: A run through the games arcade mode (submission video is from another marathon where I did this, here is my PB https://youtu.be/1N2agTIyDs4?si=mYvKNdFKfG55qPtq). Possible for donation incentive for team etc.
categories.name: Arcade Mode Very Easy

games.description: The PC port of the 2nd version of Marvel vs Capcom 3.
games.name: Ultimate Marvel vs Capcom 3

categories.description:
The category allows RNG manipulations and a sequence break to skip the Rocket Hideout section of the games.
This is the fastest glitchless route for the game, using Nidoking as the main.
categories.name: Any% Glitchless

games.description:
Pokemon Yellow is the final game released for Generation 1. 
It loosely follows the Pokemon anime, including your starter being a Pikachu, fighting Jessie & James, Surge having an OP Raichu, etc.
The gym leaders and Elite 4 were significantly buffed from Red/Blue.
games.name: Pokemon Yellow

categories.description: This run randomises 32 Nintendo tracks from past & future Mario Kart titles. This run has 200+ tracks to choose from so runs are very interesting. Whilst this run isn't an official category, it is massively inspired by the CTGP Randomiser speedrun.
categories.name: 32 Track Randomiser

games.description: Retro Rewind is a mod for Mario Kart Wii. It has every Nintendo track from Super Mario Kart to MK7. It also has a bunch of tracks from MK8, Tour and World. Retro Rewind is the most popular way to play Mario Kart Wii in 2026.
games.name: Retro Rewind (Mario Kart Wii)

categories.description: In any% you have to collect 120 sun medals and 80 moon medals to complete the game. Any% shows a multiple high-speed skips during the day whilst showing off wall clip glitches, boss phase skips and EXP exploits at night. Definitely one of the more interesting speedruns in the sonic series
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Sonic Unleashed Recompiled is a fan made PC port of Sonic Unleashed. It plays mostly the same as console with a few quality of life features. Sonic Unleashed is split into 2 gameplay types, High speed boost gameplay at day and slower combat gameplay at night.
games.name: Sonic Unleashed (Recompiled)

categories.description: This run showcases 32 random custom tracks (or Nintendo Tracks) that are in CTGP. There are 248 tracks for the game to randomise so no two runs are ever the same.
categories.name: 32 Track Randomiser

games.description: CTGP is a mod made for Mario Kart Wii. The mod adds over 200 custom tracks with new game modes, time trials and online support.
games.name: CTGP Revolution (Mario Kart Wii)

categories.description: Finish the game as soon as possible, without needing to collect any cans nor watch any cutscenes.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: Finish the game as soon as possible while watching all the cutscenes. This category is more suitable for marathon events because the audience will be able to watch the funny and silly cutscenes and know the plot. The cutscenes also give runners more time for commentary.
categories.name: Cutscene%

games.description: Released in 1999, Pepsiman is based on the eponymous Japanese superhero mascot for the American carbonated soft drink Pepsi. It focuses the player on avoiding obstacles by running, dashing, and jumping, while Pepsiman automatically runs forward through each of the game's stages.
games.name: Pepsiman

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A Bug's Life is a 3D platformer video game based on the Disney/Pixar 1998 film of the same name.
games.name: A Bug's Life

categories.description: The category they don't tell you about at school! Something cool about DKR/DS is the track/vehicle variations you can play - there are 47, and this category plays them all. This gives plenty of time for each vehicle to shine, especially Hovercraft, which is playable on every track.
categories.name: All Races, All Vehicles

categories.description: All Trophy Races (ATR) takes us through all 20 tracks as fast as possible, showing off all aspects of this game's beautifully intricate movement and speed tech. Car, Hovercraft, Plane and out-of-bounds races are all present. With two of the top runners playing, a race of ATR can be incredibly tense.
categories.name: All Trophy Races

categories.description: 100% is DKR's star attraction and showcases every part of the game, including every track and plenty of glitches. The wrong warp and trophy storage glitches give 100% a complicated but beautiful route - with two runners, there's a higher chance of diverging routes in the middle of the run!

games.description: Diddy Kong Racing is totally better than that other racing game on the N64, featuring three different vehicles and incredibly fast movement, and having a nearly limitless skill ceiling. This 1997 racer has maintained an active community to this day, though it's surprisingly not as popular as you'd expect, given it's the 8th-best selling game on the N64! There are so many things you can do in DKR, from Time Trials to full-game and everything in between; this game is a real treat at any marathon.
games.name: Diddy Kong Racing

categories.description: Any% is a very fun and fast category, with not too much time spent backtracking for quests. Thanks to randomised warp rooms and some farming for items, the run feels fresh every time. Any% can also very easily be upgraded to All Upgrades via incentive, as the route is the same for the first half.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: All Upgrades is very similar to Any% (having the exact same route for the first half), featuring 4-5 extra minutes of backtracking to fetch an item for each of our partners. This takes us through a few rooms that aren't normally seen, and the items allow us to do some more creative stuff at the end.
categories.name: All Upgrades

games.description: Yohane the Parhelion -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE-, released November 2023, is a game that nobody saw coming: a Metroidvania, based on a spin-off of the Love Live! anime series. Although the game is fairly new, the route is well-established and makes smart use of what the underwater dungeon offers us. With very quick and flashy kills that can be done on the 21 bossfights, and nine partners to use throughout the game, Any% and All Upgrades (the two main categories) are beatable in under an hour.
games.name: Yohane the Parhelion -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE-

categories.description: The shortest and most popular category, Any% is easy enough to follow, but can get really hard in the second half with the marked difficulty spike. Modern Mode is not featured in the original Wii game, and gives us an extra heart for each Kong to do some extra damage boost strats here and there.
categories.name: Any% (Modern Mode)

games.description: Donkey Kong Country Returns HD is a recently released remake of one of the best platformers on the Wii, from 2010. Compared to the original, the speedrun is a bit different, mainly due to the v1.1.0 update released in 2026 that introduced Dixie Kong - there are also a number of physics changes and other small differences. HD is the most accessible version of DKCR and, with the new Dixie skips, is a very entertaining run to have at any marathon, especially at high level.
games.name: Donkey Kong Country Returns HD

categories.description: All 30 levels, on the Ultra Violence (hardest except for Nightmare) difficulty. It's a brutal gauntlet with tons of tricks and skips, much more than in Doom 1. I've just learnt the run (submission video is 2nd completed run) so I should be able to do 45 minutes for a marathon with more practice.
categories.name: UV-Speed

games.description: Original Doom 2, but the modern official Kex Port. It's completely identical to the original in terms of game behavior (including glitches), but with modern tweaks such as high quality graphics, and accessibility options etc. Changes to the controls make several tricks harder in this version though - specifically the ability to look in more than 256 directions (which makes it harder to look in an exact direction) and the inability to move slowly with vertical mouse movement.
games.name: Doom 2 (Kex Port)

categories.description: I'll showoff the game up to the highest difficulty songs, and then also show off performer mode (super hard mode with many extra inputs).
categories.name: Showcase

games.description: A rhythm game reminiscent of Rift of the NecroDancer, but less gimmicks, more like a traditional rhythm game with accuracy windows etc. You kill enemies to the music with regular attacks, special attacks, jump attacks and hitting glide notes. This game as a streamer policy you can find here: https://www.kingdomhearts.com/melody-of-memory/en-us/streaming-guidelines/ the tl;dr is they don't want you to play the Utada or Disney songs, I could easily avoid them if you want (though they are iconic).
games.name: Kingdom Hearts: Melody of Memory

categories.description: Mow all the lawns
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: Keep mowin' mowin' mowin' mowin'
games.name: Lawn Mower

categories.description: RE8 will be played through on the highest difficulty VoS (Village of Shadows) without Out Of Bounds glitches nor any New Game+ equipment. The roughly ten minutes long intro will be skipped and the runner starts from a specific save state with limited inventory and weapons.
categories.name: VoS (No Intro/Siege) - Glitchless

games.description: Resident Evil Village is a survival horror game developed and published by Capcom. It is the sequel to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard and the tenth main game of the Resident Evil series. It follows Ethan Winters' story after the events of Resident Evil 7, this time in a remote village in in Eastern Europe. Ethan searches for his family after an attack leaves him stranded. RE: Village blends tense exploration, resource management, action heavy encounters and atmospheric horror.
games.name: Resident Evil Village

categories.description: Pure Minimalist removes nearly every safety net: No blood collector, no crafting, no healing, no shop, no upgrades, no charms. The run depends on random drops, creating a faster paced and high risk showcase of adaptation, resource management and decision making. Its easy to live-explain and follow.
categories.name: Pure Minimalist

games.description: Resident Evil Requiem is a survival horror game developed and published by Capcom, a survival horror game in which FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft and Leon S. Kennedy investigate a string of deaths connected to the infamous Raccoon City incident. Their intertwined stories combine horror, action, resource management and classic Leon humor.
games.name: Resident Evil Requiem

categories.description: The 0-20 run increases in complexity as the levels become more packed, level 20 containing the maximum number of viruses allowed. The GameBoy version is unique because of the smaller size of the pill bottle as well as some "impossible" level 19's and 20's.  The RNG is also more favorable than NES.

games.description: Dr. Mario is a puzzle game where falling pills are used to destroy viruses of three different colors in a Tetris-like environment.  This is done by matching four of one color (3 pill halves plus 1 virus, 2 pill halves plus 1 virus etc.).  Each level features an increasing number of viruses, with level 0 beginning with 4 viruses and level 20 containing 84.  The run requires quick puzzle solving as well as quick pill manipulation around the bottle.
games.name: Dr. Mario

categories.description: Z3 is the hardest difficulty in the game where every enemy is level 140 and you start at level 0. The AI is absolutely fucking brutal on this difficulty, and one mistakes can make you lose 50% of your health easily. Breakthrough is kind of like New game+, I have all the transformations in the game.
categories.name: Goku's Story (Z3, Breakthrough)

games.description: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 3 is one of the best fighting games on the PS2. You can play through the Dragon Universe story mode with up to 9 different characters, all having their own speedrun. The mechanics of this game are incredibly deep, and it will blow peoples minds. Every fight in the game will require full silence from the audience as they are all insanely hard. The game is a spectacle, speaks for itself and so do the combos. I am offering to make this run your opener of the event.
games.name: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 3

categories.description:
Stake Climb is how you "beat" the game on the hardest difficulty. It gets progressively harder. I personally think that the standard difficulty lacks stake (ha ha, get it...?) it's too easy, you can't fail.
On the higher stakes / difficulties, a win isn't given. It's hard and hype!
categories.name: Stake Climb

games.description:
Everyone knows (or should know) Balatro. Play poker hands with modifiers are score big
Everyone loves when numbers go brr and my Blueprint retriggers my Mine!

categories.description: All Peak Race is the main category of SSX 3, and is an incredibly unique concept for a racing game, as it sees you play every race track in the game, continuously, as you ride all the way from the top of the mountain to the bottom. No loading screens, no downtime, just nonstop speedrunning.
categories.name: All Peak Race

games.description: SSX 3 is a snowboarding racing game made in 2003 for the PS2, Xbox, and Gamecube. The game is full of incredible tricks, tight controls, and of course, incredible music. SSX 3 is widely regarded as one of the best games of the 6th generation, and the speedrun follows in that vein.
games.name: SSX 3

categories.description: the 100% category involves beating every race and unlocking every character, by beating every boss race. There are 15 races in this speedrun, and winning every race in each Grand Prix is what unlocks said boss race.

games.description: Speed Punks is a PS1 Racing game that takes inspiration from all types of fantastic racing games from the era, which leads to it being an incredibly well fleshed out racing game considering its niche notoriety. It has incredible track design, which when combined with its mechanics, makes for a very fun watch.
games.name: Speed Punks

categories.description: This is a normal CTR run except for EVERY item in the game that you collect in the adventure mode is random, as well as the requirements to unlock every single track, so the skips, the tricks and the driving is all still there, leading to a fun run which still represents what makes the game great!
categories.name: Randomizer

categories.description: This is one of many custom tracks adventure modes that have been made for Crash Team Racing, involving custom tracks made by the community, with functioning AI to race against and times to beat to advance.
categories.name: Custom Track Adventure Mode

games.description: CTR is a Racing game for the PS1 that has everything that a racing game should have, Technical driving, cornering and drifting that is simple to understand, difficult to master but easy to explain fundamentals, and insane skips that are easy on the eye. This game is a perfect example of a racing game that lends itself to speedrunning. (This will be ran on Duckstation emulator due to it being a randomizer seed/mod)
games.name: Crash Team Racing

categories.description:
This category sees you beat Novice Difficulty in Championship Mode, the Any% equivalent of this game. The objective is to beat 3 levels in 6 Rally Countries, starting in New Zealand, and ending in Corsica/France. 
There are 18 levels in total, a perfect length for a showcase.
categories.name: Championship: Novice

games.description: Colin McRae Rally is a PS1 Racing/Rally Game from 1998 and was the quintessential "realistic" racing game of its time. It sees you go through several countries with many different rally tracks, with the intention of racing though them as quickly as possible. This game is a absolute nostalgia trip for many a racing game and PlayStation enthusiast, and is sure to be of interest even to those who don't know the game, due to how easy it is to grasp.  (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Colin McRae Rally

categories.description: Any% sees you beat the story mode of the game, ending on the final boss. This run allows everything this game has to offer, crazy glitches and all, which allows for a fantastic showcase.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Croc 2 is a platformer for the PS1 that sees you traverse 4 worlds, battling pits, tricky jumps, and bosses. This game as a speedrun however allows for a lot of eye catching tricks and tech that are not often associated with a 3D platformer of its kind, allowing for a unique showcase that sets it apart from Croc 1, and other games in the series. (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Croc 2

categories.name: All Dungeons

games.description: Released in 2011 for the 25th Zelda anniversary, Skyward Sword is an amazing 3D Zelda adventure while utilizes a lot of the motion controls from the Wii. This version in particular is incredibly broken thanks to a glitch called "Back in Time", which allows you to tear the game apart by controling Link in the title screen and setting arbitrary flags to skip a lot of the story progression.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: Collect the 4 Mirror Shards as fast as possible by beating the 4 dungeons that each contain a Mirror Shard. This is similar to the middle/end of an Any% run, but also includes an additional dungeon. The run starts from a pre-made file after MDH.
categories.name: All Mirror Shards

games.description: Released on the Gamecube and Wii in 2006, Twilight Princess is one of the most adored Zelda games in the series, from its characters and story all the way to its cool dungeons and gameplay mechanics. Same can be said for the speedrun, as it has one of the more active communities out there. This game features a lot of cool looking and flashy movement tricks, as well as a lot of complitated setups for various sequence breaks and other skips which have only recently been discovered.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible. This category in particular includes a decent balance between movement-based tricks inside of the levels, as well as huge out-of-bounds glitches to skip a lot of other levels and cutscenes.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible while collecting everything. This category has no glitches and is very movement focused, showing cool 100%-exclusive movement and badge/item strategies unseen in other categories.
categories.name: 100% (Standees)

categories.description: Beat all of the Koopalings as fast as possible. This category is part of Bellabel Park DLC for Switch 2 and shows a lot of the contents from the "Any% NMG" category from the Switch 1 edition, but also includes bossfights against the newly added Koopalings.
categories.name: All Koopalings

games.description: Released in October 2023, this is the latest installment in the 2D Mario series, featuring a ton of unique power-ups, badges and other quirks unseen before. In regards to the speedrun for it, it is unlike any 2D Mario from before and includes incredible movement-based tricks inside of the levels, as well as complicated, but mesmerizing glitches in the overworld. Additionally, the newly released Bellabel Park DLC includes cool new bossfights, maybe the best in the 2D Mario series.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder

categories.description: Collect the Harp as fast as possible. This is done by beating the first 3 dungeons of the game and is basically the "first half" of a typical Any% speedrun.
categories.name: Harp%

games.description: Released in 2021 as a Switch Remaster of the original Wii title, this version features a lot of quality-of-life features like faster loads, high-definition graphics, 60fps, fast text and button controls. While it uses little glitches, it instead focuses on movement optimization and smaller tricks that save a couple of seconds. In turn, more of the base game is visible and makes this run very close to a "glitchless" experience while still featuring unique strategies.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD

categories.description: Beat All Grand Prix Cups as fast as possible. This category is a good balance between driving skills and item management, while still showing of the mario kart item craziness that we all know and love.
categories.name: All Grand Prix

games.description: Released in 2025, Mario Kart World is the latest installment of the Mario Kart series after many years. It includes a ton of new mechanics unseen in older Mario Kart games such as rail/wall grinding and more trickable surfaces for a ton of unique shortcuts.
games.name: Mario Kart World

categories.description: A run of the entire game which includes completing all paths. This run features a lot of good movement, and knowing how to pick your fights to proceed as fast as possible through the levels while still collecting enough XP designed for your own route.
categories.name: Any%(Solo)

games.description: We have seen the movies, time to enjoy the action as a speedrun! This is among the top of my childhood games, and also games to speedrun. It's a hack & slash game released on PC and 6th generation of consoles. The game is based on the movie with the same name, but also features content from the second movie. It even has cutscenes taken right from the movie that transitions into gameplay! It features most of the characters of the Fellowship with their own set of abilities, and some shared ones.
games.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

categories.description: True End Nightmare consists of playing the game on the hardest difficulty (Nightmare) and achieving the True ending for the game which simply adds an additional extra fight boss fight at the end if you meet the required criteria so it ends up becoming the main category of the game.
categories.name: True End Nightmare

games.description: The game is action/horror based. Developed by Bokeh studio, the same team behind Silent Hill and Siren series. It is about some type of parasitic alien forms taking over humans in a fictional city named Kowlong (based on the real walled city of Kowloon). We play as a formless spirit who has lost its memories, going around possessing humans to stop the enemy threat while discovering how to recover its memories and find the reason behind all that is happening.
games.name: Slitterhead

categories.description: Any% Story consists of completing a new game on the easiest difficulty by any means possible. We start from scratch and have to obtain every resource and powerups along way. It is a showcase of optimized pathing and combat, while abusing some glitches along the way, the most impactful being skating.
categories.name: Any% Story Unrestricted

categories.description: Any% Nightmare consists of completing a new game on the hardest difficulty by any means possible. We start from scratch and have to obtain every resource and powerups along way. Resources are very limited on this difficulty, so this is a showcase of very optimized routing and a some glitches.
categories.name: Any% Nightmare Unrestricted

games.description: The second remake of the classic japanese horror title Fatal Frame 2. Now with new mechanics and up to date graphics and quality of life changes, we return to Minakami Village as Mio and Mayu and re-explore the area with newly added locations and uncover the mysteries surrounding the residents, all while surviving the onslaught of specters and wraith ghosts trying to stand in our way with our trusty staple camera obscura.
games.name: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly (2026)

categories.description: The category I was (sadly) too sick to do at Winter! In the Any% Triathlon category, the goal is to beat all three Spelunky games in a row. All three games follow the same formula: beat a bunch of randomly generated levels (spread across a few different worlds), then defeat the boss.
categories.name: Triathlon - Any%

games.description: Spelunky is an indie platformer roguelike, infamous for its difficulty. There are three games in the series: the freeware original from 2008 (Spelunky 'Classic'), the well-known HD remake from 2012 (Spelunky 'HD'), and the long-awaited sequel from 2020 (Spelunky 2). Every level is randomly generated, so you have to adapt on the fly to enemy spawns, item locations, and everything else!
games.name: Spelunky Series

categories.description: Another run I was scheduled to do at Winter, but sadly got too sick to do it! Cyber Owls is UFO 50's answer to Action 52's Cheetahmen. You play as four different characters, each with their own distinct gameplay style. For example, one character, Guin, has NES Metal Gear-style stealth gameplay!
categories.name: Cyber Owls (Gold)

categories.description: Porgy is an underwater metroidvania, and in my opinion, one of the best looking games in UFO 50. Spotlight% is a modified version of the Gold Disk run (aka Any%) which is more marathon safe (and IMO more interesting too). We equip items, beat minibosses, do skips, and get to the bottom of the sea!
categories.name: Porgy (Spotlight%)

categories.description: Every UFO 50 run I've done at ESA so far is just one of 50 games. How about a bunch of them in a row? For this run, we beat all 10 games in the top row of the game selection screen, back to back to back. Platformers, puzzlers, strategy games, and more. A true "marathon within a marathon" experience!
categories.name: Row 1 Gold Disks

categories.description: UFO 50's take on Smash TV. You have to survive against multiple waves of enemies in an arena, with the option to increase your wager (and fight even more enemies) for extra powerups. The gold category is just any%, so we buy as few upgrades as possible & rush to the final boss!
categories.name: Overbold (Gold)

categories.description: Planet Zoldath is a procedurally generated adventure game. It's often described as being like a Zelda randomiser, but if the game was like that on purpose! Gotta adapt on the fly to equipment locations, enemy behaviour and map layout. Find 3 map pieces, then get back to the ship!
categories.name: Planet Zoldath

categories.description: Similar idea to Row 1 Gold Disks, but instead of the games in the top row, the goal is to beat ANY of the 10 games! Naturally, this means we pick 10 of the fastest games in the collection. Lots of variety in this category! Platformers, puzzle games, sports games, and more!
categories.name: 10 Gold Disks

categories.description: Night Manor is a horror/point-and-click adventure game, and the only game like it in UFO 50. As there's no way to control the cursor with a mouse, the main skill expression is clean cursor movement, as well as quickly mashing through item pickups & dialogue. Cherry is the true ending category!
categories.name: Night Manor (Cherry)

games.description:
UFO 50 is a collection of 50 different retro-style games, including a variety of different genres and game lengths. Each game in UFO 50 is its own fully-fledged game, each with their own unique speedruns and strategies. Most UFO 50 categories involve running one of the 50 games, but there are also marathon categories where you beat several of them back to back.

(note: Planet Zoldath is already included in row 1 gold disks, but I submitted it separately, too.)

This level is one of the highest rated levels to be made in Dreams and it shows as it feels and plays like a new Banjo game. The level is designed around Treasure Trove Cove but with new collectible locations, map layout, moveset overhaul and sytem mechanics.
You collect Notes, Jiggies and Jinjos to 100% complete the level.

I currently run in English. Switching to Japanese will automatically shave off quite bit of time.

Thank you!

categories.description: Any% is the most common category and the one most people know. It visits 8 of the 12 whimsical stages, and because it’s ran the most, the route is highly optimized and moves FAST. Because of that, each successful strat and every small mistake can have a costly effect on the outcome of my run!
categories.name: any%

games.description: Chip ‘n Dale (CnD) is a beloved NES platformer that brings a lot of nostalgia and is a fan fav in speedrunning! Because the RNG is locked before the run starts (part of why I chose it as my first NES speedrun!), it’s all about execution, which makes it a great showcase of clean movement and skill. The run is around 10 mins and moves quickly, with fast stages and boss fights that can make or break a run. Its nostalgic charm, great OST, and fast & intense pace make it a fun watch for everyone :)
games.name: Chip 'n Dale

categories.description: Talkatoo Dark side is an unofficial combination of two categories, Talkatoo% and Dark Side. Talkatoo% is a sort of randomizer, utilizing the titular Talkatoo. He is a bird who gives you moon names as hints, which must then be collected. Dark Side refers to a  kingdom unlocked by collecting 250 moons

categories.description: Darker Side is Odysseys last kingdom, unlocking once the player has collected 500 moons, compared to the 124 required to beat the game. Getting that many moons requires revisiting most of the kingdoms, while still keeping up a high pace; no moon takes more than 18 seconds to collect optimally.
categories.name: Darker Side

Its most unique feature is Marios Companion Cappy, who can both aid his movement and take control of most enemies in the game. It offers a blend of movement and glitches no other game can offer.
