It is fast paced, while still allowing a more casual viewer to understand what is happening.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: A good-old honest any% playthrough. We'll complete all campaign missions (& some bonus ones) - but not always in the intended manner :) - before beating the game. We start with nothing and build up our weapons & speedtech as the run progresses. Brutal precision while juggling XP, what's not to love?
categories.name: Any% no LC

categories.description: The cycles are brutal, the weapons are OP, the challenges are lightning-fast: welcome to NG+ no LC. It's an insanely optimised gauntlet of all 59 main campaign challenges, where you start with maxed out weapons & items, and the only objective is to beat everything as fast as possible. So much fun :)
categories.name: NG+ no LC

games.description: Ratchet: Deadlocked (or Ratchet: Gladiator) is the 4th instalment in the Ratchet & Clank franchise. In terms of speedrunning, it has the clean movement of its predecessors via traversal missions, with its own precision-focused flair managing objective missions, along with some good old fashioned, highly-optimised arena combat.
games.name: Ratchet: Deadlocked

categories.description: Complete the game using 12 out of the 29 total dungeons on normal difficulty. We manipulate bosses to lock them in place and carefully route EXP and items to always have precisely the bare minimum available.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Hideo Kojima wants gamers to go outside more, so he put a solar sensor into his vampire hunting stealth action game. However, to make speedruns more practical, we use a UV flashlight to bring the power of the sun indoors. Django has to use both stealth and the Solar Gun to avenge his father and save the world from the Immortals. This game places a heavier focus on the stealth mechanics than its sequels.
games.name: Boktai: The Sun is in Your Hand

categories.description:
After last year's tournament.  Some players really wanted this to be on the main stream.
Ideally Stream 2 as:
1) That stream has breaks by the end of day.
2) Non-speedrunning nature of this showcase could go under/over estimate.
Doubles format - Gen 3 on Pkmn XD 
4p = 3 sets, Bo3
8p = 7 sets, Bo3.
categories.name: 4/8 players Tournament - Doubles Format.

games.description:
This is the sequel to Colosseum in terms of story. 
It's also a partial sequel to the whole bring your handheld teams over to the big screen element.

The tournament showcase could be moderately short or long depending on player count.
Discussion about this will be on ESA's Discord, so there is a good chance there will be adjustments to the submitted category.
The game itself will be slightly modified to have its main battle music removed to allow other suitable Pokémon BGMs to be played over it
games.name: Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness

categories.description: Adam Jensen can use whatever he wants to do as little as possible to solve a global conspiracy because he just couldn't be bothered. He didn't ask for this.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Everybody's favorite ultrajank action RPG. Fast blink movement, OOBs, french, big skips, stealing alcohol from the homeless, this game has it all. It's also set in Prague, which is where I live, so that's nice I guess.

Pls only take one of my submissions. If it's between this and Tango, pls take Tango. Ty <3 #speedfam
games.name: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided

categories.description:
The intended way to play the game, no looking into other player's monitor. Pure communication.

We don't have a valid submission video, but trust 🙏
categories.name: Intended%

games.description:
A coop game, where one runner plays as an agent in the field, and other plays as a remote hackerman. Very fun, light-hearted, a nice watch. Game all about communication, memorizing a lot of info, and it even has some speedtech. We might even bring some appropriate costumes.

Pls only take one of my submissions. If it's between this and Deus Ex, pls take this. Ty <3 #speedfam
games.name: Operation Tango

categories.description: No LTS removes "Lava Tube Skip," essentially making it so the runner is required to collect the minimum amount of intended "power cells" (72) to beat the game. This category is an excellent balance of speedrun skips/ tech and intended game mechanics.
categories.name: No LTS

games.description: Jak and Daxter has some classic cool movement I'm sure we're all familiar with by this point, however I plan on showcasing some large flashy skips that have not been shown before. Overall, I think it's a fun classic that has excellent pacing and some impressive tricks!
games.name: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy

categories.description:
#speedfam. The most classic way to speedrun JK2, the main goal is to do all levels and beat Desann at the end.
All glitches are allowed, but using cheats is not.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
#speedfam. Second game in the trilogy of the Jedi Knight, right before Jedi Academy, here we play as Kyle Katarn.
This game is based on the Quake3 engine, so expect strafes jumping, bunnyhop, glitch abuse, lot of RNG and save reloads.
games.name: Star Wars : Jedi Knight II : Jedi Outcast

categories.description:
Max Ratings is like Silent Assassin in the other Hitman games, as in keeping things stealthy and clean according to the game. Which is the fun part because we really get to stretch the definition of what's stealthy.

If accepted, I would prefer to do the run on the second stream.
categories.name: Max Ratings

games.description: Stealth game where you sneak around in disguises and assassinate people. Absolution is often considered the black sheep of the series as the maps are more linear than in the other games, but it's still one of the more popular games in the series. In a speedrun you get to make the AI look clueless and exploit the rating system to get away with dumb things.
games.name: Hitman: Absolution

categories.description: Use all items you get in the game in NG+ for total house destruction
categories.name: All Gifts NG+

games.description: This is a game about a little muddy puppy who is left home alone.. the goal.. total destruction
games.name: Doronko Wanko

categories.description: No intro to this one, but WHY NOT! its just silly!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Help Pat save the day..
games.name: Postman Pat PS2

categories.description: Quickly get the otter pups through the map using.. not so intended means to get the ulitmate collectable.. STAMPS
categories.name: Any %

games.description: 2 little otters on a journey for stamps!
games.name: That One Otter Game

categories.description: In this category i have to get all the extras in a pretty much 100% category.
categories.name: All Achievements

games.description: Help guide Smushi home from being taken away from his family.
games.name: Smushi Come Home

categories.description: Sorry no intro- Using the spyro the dragon skin, quickly get all the power ups from each hub and reach the top of the mountain!
categories.name: All Butt Powers

games.description: Its back, get the little doggy to the top of the mountain!!
games.name: A Corgi's Cozy Hike

categories.description: 15 Card Mod of Any%. You get way more cards per drop (15 instead of 1) in this compared to the normal Any% category, this makes it more marathon friendly since you can farm a lot more solid cards safely and thus have a better chance to beat the notoriously difficult endgame.
categories.name: Any% (15 Card Mod)

games.description: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories. Old Yu-Gi-Oh game that differs a lot from the actual card game, very RNG but also knowledge based, where you alter your gameplay and decision making based on RNG factors.
games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories

categories.description: Deedlit 3-in-1 is a speedrun of the game where the most difficult settings are turned on. Spirit level, your level, and HP are all locked at 1, meaning you die in a single hit and will deal reduced damage. Deaths are allowed and expected. No OOB.
categories.name: 3-in-1

games.description: Record of Lodoss War: Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth is a metroidvania game that focusses on our favourite elf from Lodoss, Deedlit! Deedlit wakes up in a mysterious labyrinth where enemies from her past are revived to fight her. Deedlit must explore the labyrinth, collect weapons and spirit magic, and see what lies at the heart of this strange dream.
games.name: Record of Lodoss War: Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth

categories.description: Using warp zones and appropriate character choice, skip all the way to the end of the game and beat the final boss in less than 20 minutes!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Mario 2 on the GBA. Mario and friends find themselves adventuring in a dream world called Subcon, working to defeat the evil ruler Wart. The GBA version has enhanced graphics, but is actually so close to the original that many of the same glitches and tricks apply.
games.name: Super Mario Advance

categories.description: In 100%, you visit every stage, rescue every maiden, then defeat Dracula. The percentage is tracked on the game's file select, so you can see your percentage any time you go back. You play as Richter at the start, then unlock Maria, who is much faster.
This run starts at stage 1 (Rather than stage 0) and you play as Maria the entire game and finish as fast as you can. Maria's very quick movement and powerful attacks make for a short and sweet run.
categories.name: Maria Only Any%

games.description: Castlevania: Rondo of Blood is a fast paced outing to Dracula's Castle starring Richter Belmont and Maria Renard, who would both return in Symphony of the Night. Dracula has kidnapped several maidens for his sicko rituals, and it's time to take the fight to him and save Transylvania again. The PS4 version is slightly easier than the original on the Turbografx-16.
games.name: Castlevania: Rondo of Blood

categories.description: Complete the game as fast as possible, and defeat Spat!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Hamtaro and the gang return in an adventure about saving love and friendship! An evil hamster named Spat has arrived in town and has started making trouble, pitting friends against each other. Hamtaro and Bijou must help various hamsters with their troubles and defeat Spat! An adventure game with a cute twist in the hamster's special language, which have very expressive animations.
games.name: Hamtaro: Ham Ham Heartbreak

categories.description: Season 5 of Racing+ is the ruleset furthest away from vanilla game, yet with a cool rng-heavy twist. It utilizes unused coop babies, with each of the 600+ babies being given a unique effect, ranging from good to pretty awful, testing both player's skill and resistance to pressing alt+f4 #speedfam
categories.name: R+7 (S5)

games.description: The Binding of Isaac is an rng-based roguelike and Repentance is the penultimate DLC for it, but the last one that has a speedrunning mod for it. Get a starting item(s), fight the floors each ending with a boss, reach the final floor, kill the final boss, repeat several times (usually 7 with different characters). Runs are done using the mod called Racing+ (R+) that speeds up the game by removing cutscenes and speeding up the process of finding an item that would be sufficient to start the run.
games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance

categories.description: Any% is completing the game as intended, from beginning to end. No major glitches.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Platformer about a ninja who is on a mission to save his Dad, and ends up saving the world and getting the girl.
games.name: Ninja Gaiden

categories.description: 100% requires you to face and beat all teams, including the Shadow team at the end.
categories.name: 100% Easy

games.description: A dodgeball game where you tour the world eliminating all other dodgeball teams on the way to face a shadow team of yourself. Seems simple on the surface but there is alot of nuance.
games.name: Super Dodge Ball

categories.description: Any% you just simply complete all the tasks that take you to the final boss, and then beat the boss. You get a fun little game over screen.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A short, quirky homebrew where you are a Letter 0 from a Game Over screen going on a journey to save the world... maybe...
games.name: Star Evil (Pubby)

categories.description: 100% requires you to collect all the diamonds in a stage before you can successfully access the exit. This will allow for a more complete showing of the stages, but is really only a couple minutes longer than Any%.

games.description: A homebrew based upon a Youtube meme of a universe where a Cube battles it's evil foe, Cone. In the game, you move through four stages and confront Cone in the final battle. A friend made this game and it was well received on speedrun.com so while it's more casual than difficult, it would be a great way to honor his work.
games.name: Cube

categories.description: Any% allows you to do whatever it takes to get to the end. There are strategic ways to not hit certain checkpoints so that you can pop yourself after collecting things and skip back to the route quickly. I will likely take is safe and hit most checkpoints, but it's Any% nonetheless.
categories.name: Any% (v1.1)

games.description: A Metroidvania where you are a Bubble that is trying to move through numerous obstacles to get to your final destination. Throughout, you pick up additional skills that are required to advance through the stages.
games.name: Bobl

categories.description: Co-op race with mrockstar20, and ApolloSmug (WR holder) on commentary. Any% is the fastest way to use glitches and clips to get to the end. It is easy to consume visually and Apollo will help chat navigate it.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Game features Harry trying to save his daughter from the dangerous villains. With the true final boss being THE WALL!
games.name: Super Pitfall

categories.description: Any% doesn't have any major glitches (yet!), so we get to play through each level of the game in order. However, there are several minor skips and cool tech such as dash cancels, instant kick-backs, and damage boosts. There's also a trick called Proxy Jump, which is similar to Hollow Knight's pogo!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: From GameFreak (the same developers as Pokemon), Drill Dozer is a 2D platformer released in 2006 in North America, with a unique drill mechanic that allows you to use the triggers to drill blocks, hit enemies, and traverse terrain. There are only two GBA games with a built-in rumble pack, and this is one of them! If you're a Gen 3 Pokemon fan, you'll likely recognize a lot of sound effects from this game, as they use the same sound library.
games.name: Drill Dozer

categories.description: Gen 3 glitches have developed a TON in the past 2 years, to the point where we have a separate NSC category! The route takes advantage of some really cool RNG manipulations to beat Roxanne while severely under-leveled, before doing a credits warp with Mail, plus the potential for glitch showcases.
categories.name: Any% No Save Corruption

games.description: Pokemon Ruby/Sapphire are the first Hoenn games in the series. They feature Team Magma/Aqua as the evil team as well as a ton of new Pokemon introduced in this generation! This, combined with very strong RNG manipulation potential, fluid movement, and many recently discovered glitches, makes for a fast-paced and unique game.
games.name: Pokemon Sapphire

categories.description: This is a 2-player co-op category that has 2 components: mini-games and the boat. The goal is to complete 10 mini-games as fast as possible while keeping the boat upright. After each co-op mini-game, each player must place a Mii on the boat in a way that keeps it balanced, which is hard to do fast!
categories.name: Balance Boat (Beginner, 2 Player)

games.description: Wii Party is a casual multiplayer party game for the Wii with dozens of different mini-games. There are also a variety of different gamemodes like Party Games, House Party, and Pair Games. Playing with your own Miis makes for a fun viewer experience, and the mini-games are pretty silly.
games.name: Wii Party

categories.description: Bunny hopping, grenade boosting, and strafing your way through the game. No LTS (Lava Tube Skip) requires you to collect the games required amount of Power Cells to beat the game. The run showcases interesting movement tech, and unique skips.
categories.name: No LTS

games.description: A PC mod for the openGOAL port of Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy that has recoded source movement and Gordon Freeman with a gun into the playstation 2 classic.
games.name: Gordon and Daxter

categories.description: We go through the game as fast as possible. Picking up the needed powerups. There are very few backups, which just makes it more exciting!
categories.name: BTG

games.description: in 2081 monster invades earth and you are tasked with saving the planet! With time traveling! This is a stage based metroidvania style game, with cool mechanics such as the boss of each stage gaining max health depending on how fast you go.
games.name: Bio Senshi Dan

categories.description: In this category we optimize the money route to waste as little time as possible on countdowns as well as on shopping. And we pray the RNG gods are with us!
categories.name: BTG

games.description: Classic disney game! Fly your plane, deliver the gods. This is a kid friendly shmup that has some great music obviously!
games.name: Talespin

categories.description: In this game you always jump, but you can cancel the jump ascent by pressing a button. You get access to a dash later, and it's all about just managing your jump height. Also disco music will make anyone go wild!
categories.name: BTG

games.description: In this game you are a flea, traveling through some animals. You're goal is simply to survive!
games.name: FLEA!

categories.description: This is contra mode basicly. 30 lifes to beat the game. This is a adventure/metroidvania game so we are getting some powerups, but also skipping a lot, and we are abussing dmg values to make some bosses act the way we want.
categories.name: Maxime Gunn - Defeat belphegor

games.description: Infernax is a game inspired by old classics, such as castlevania 2, but more "bloody", and pays tribute to many classic games and figures from the 90's.
games.name: Infernax

categories.description: in 2024 an australian asked a swede in the bar if he could be his backup partner. in 2026 we want to just grab 2 random people joining each of us and have a blind race, showcasing that speedrunning doesn't need to be THAT serious.
categories.name: Co-Op Race "Blind partnes%"

games.description: Best Ikari game on the NES, more of a beat em up than action. You go through 6 stages beating up all the enemies.
games.name: Ikari III

categories.description: Beat em up game, using special move to kill enemies faster, and memorizing the spawning points of enemies, which some cool pixel setups for quick kills/stun locks on bosses. Playing the famicom version cause it allow for more fun movement due to jump kicks being stronger.
categories.name: BTG-J version

games.description: It's Turtles! also ninja is a scary word so we should use "Hero" instead.
games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Arcade Game

categories.description: In this category we beat the first half of the game, and trigger the first ending which is considered the bad ending. Uniqe controlls, floating, and tight movements to make sure we can make it through each stage. Also people love the one song.
categories.name: Bad Ending. No warps

games.description: In this game you travel through floors collecting keys, to unlock a door and completing the stage. there's also powerups to help you throughout the run, of most we just skip.
games.name: Quest Of Ki

categories.description: The japanese version of this game runs on a way better FPS, and feels actually good to play. We are going through the game as intended mostly, and a lot of it is just memorizing and not choking. Great music by Tim Follins
categories.name: BTG-J version

games.description: Everyone knows this game, everyone hates this game... But I wanna redeem it!
games.name: Dragon's Lair

categories.description: A lot of memory work here, remembering where to put the cursor, perform some glitches, and inventory management. There's a few skips that are quite tight, but anyone that has played the original game will recognize a lot in this game.
categories.name: BTG

games.description: A classic point and click game, which was ported to the NES, and beside the lack of music, it's actually not a TERRIBLE port.
games.name: King's Quest IV

categories.description: This is an endurance game, by that I mean you need to have the mashing strength and endurance to actually win. The better you play, the more money you have, but one mistake can snowball really quickly.
categories.name: BTG, all courses

games.description: This is not a game about the mythical animal "Bigfoot", but about the vehicles "bigfoot". It's a racing game that features 2 styles of gaming, one top down versus part, and one part mashing versus part.
games.name: Bigfoot

categories.description: It's partly a driving game, but mostly a shooter game. Has some stages that mix things up, such as "defend the kids", "Plant the bomb" and "obstacle curses"
categories.name: BTG

games.description: You are a boat, you kill other boats, but also giant serpents, giant crabs, and most importanly a shark! great classic by rare.
games.name: Cobra Triangle

categories.description: This run, as most beat em ups, are about controlling the screen. Knowing how many enemies, which to kill first, and most of all, not messing up the kills on the bosses.
categories.name: BTG

games.description: A basic beat em up game but with a lot of fun small tech. there's only a few stages, and you only have 2 lives/continues.
games.name: Target Renegade

categories.description: This run is a 1 life run. There's limited health refils. We go around the castle with some cool platforming, and utilizing the wolf form as much as we can(can only turn into the wolf in moonlight).
categories.name: BTG

games.description: You are a girl that turns into a wolf in the moonlight and is trapped in a castle. Your goal is to escape the castle in this metroidvania.
games.name: Wolfling

categories.description: We run through the game as intended. There's a lot routing around levels and weapons to make sure you can actually complete the game as well as a grind. It's a metroidvania with a lot of platforming.
categories.name: BTG - No Wrong Warp

categories.description: In this category we ignore all cool things about the game and just glitch to the end during the first level of the game!
categories.name: BTG-Wrong Warp

games.description: You're a cosmo police! You run around on an alien planet, getting levels, power ups and new weapons. You meat other people on the planet that helps you progress, destroy computers to unlock your way through, and fight bosses. Also Famicom game with amazing music!
games.name: Cosmo Police Galivan

categories.description: Might add more people, but right now we are two. Considering showing off games such as "Duck hunt" "Hogan's Alley", "Freedom Force" and more, including a final showcase of a famicom exclusive zapper game that requires a special zapper!
categories.name: Zapper showcase

games.description: Zapper games was a big part of growing up with an nintendo in the 90's, but very few has seen speedruns of those games!
games.name: Zapper showcase hour

categories.description: In this category we race all 3 stages back to back. Just like in "Modern" F-zero games, your boost is also your health, which regenerates over time. So there's a big risk vs reward situation throughout all 3 stages.
categories.name: All courses - Race

games.description: Imagine F-zero, but 8-bit!
games.name: FF-F

categories.description: We play as the fastest character, and simply beat the game. There's routing in how to use your special moves for the beat em parts to eliminate as much of the rng as possible, but also has some really intense platforming throughout the game.
categories.name: BTG

games.description: Based of the hit show rollergames! But really has little to do with it excpect for characters. You blade through the game on your rollergames, and cause of that it has a very uniqe momentum to it.
games.name: Rollergames

categories.description: The goal is to beat the Showdown King Ryo Watanabe. For this, we will try to win/dominate the race days with the least amount of races possible, which is mainly done by abusing Casual assist on drift races to score absurd amount of points we couldn't get through other race types.
categories.name: Career Any%

categories.description: The Goal is to beat all 5 Kings: Ryo and each race style's king (Grip, Drag, Speed Challenge and Drift). It needs a re-route to any% in order to get 10 track records per style to unlock the path to the Kings. The points problematic still applies but this time you have to race in all the game modes.
categories.name: Career All Kings

games.description: One of the pioneers of the "race festival" games, and quite a unique one. 4 game modes with their own physics: Grip (aka circuit), Drag, Speed Challenge and Drift
games.name: Need For Speed: ProStreet

categories.description: The goal is to beat DustinEden, the new Showdown King replacing Ryo Watanabe. To do this, we need to win and/or dominate Race Days, by scoring a lot of points in the races. Points scores depends of our times but also of our car, which makes the routing even more challenging.
categories.name: Career Any%

games.description: Mod of NFS ProStreet created by streamer DustinEden's community, it is quite a significant revamp of the original game with new cars, new events, new game modes, new storyline, new features, HD textures, and memes everywhere!
games.name: Need For Speed: ProStreet (Pepega Edition)

categories.description: The goal is to win the first division of the Stock Car game mode (just normal racing). Retiring races isn't allowed in this category. You start further and further behind on the grid as you go up the divisions, with such an agressive AI it makes for very spicy and chaotic racing
categories.name: Stock Car (All Races)

games.description: A long time extinct franchise whom the first 2 games had great success on the PlayStation. it's focused on action packed very agressive racing on fantasy track, with cars roughly looking like nascars
games.name: Destruction Derby 2

categories.description: In this category, the objective is to complete all 48 main levels from a new file in order. Timing starts upon gaining movement of the Goo in the first level Let There Be Goo, and it ends upon completing the last level, All the Way Down.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: You play as the Grey Goo which eats objects smaller than it, and it grows larger and larger as it eats until it reaches a certain size or after eating a certain amount of a certain item. There are nearly 50 levels of varying length and there are six time periods in this game. Everything is done with the mouse; the movement of the Goo, the menuing, etc.
games.name: Tasty Planet: Back for Seconds

categories.description:
Any% Arcade requires the player to catch 5 fish within 5 minutes for each level. Race through 12 levels and timer ends after the last Results Screen.

Superdave2 plays on PS2, and I (Zingochris) play on Duckstation Emulator.
categories.name: Any% Arcade

games.description: This is a fishing game that takes place through 12 levels across the world. There are three modes playable: Arcade, Recreation, and Tournament. All fish caught are logged into the Gallery.
games.name: Saltwater Sportfishing

categories.description: The Manipless (no RNG manipulation) category took off in popularity in early 2021 and became the point of entry for many new Pokémon speedrunners. With no barrier to entry and no stat requirements, it's a very accessible run with a high skill ceiling and room for adaptation. 3 main switches is fun!
categories.name: Glitchless Manipless

categories.description: The Manipless (no RNG manipulation) category took off in popularity in early 2021 and became the point of entry for many new Pokémon speedrunners. With no barrier to entry and no stat requirements, it's a very accessible run with a high skill ceiling and room for adaptation. 3 main switches is fun!
categories.name: Glitchless Manipless

games.description: Pokémon HG/SS are 2009 remakes of the iconic Gold/Silver from 1999. As part of the fourth generation of Pokémon games, they are amongst the most beloved titles of the series combining both the Johto and Kanto regions into a 16 gym badge experience. A solitary trainer atop Mt. Silver forms an epic conclusion to a fantastic RPG.
games.name: Pokémon HeartGold/SoulSilver

categories.description: Any% Glitchless aims to become the Champion. Team Aqua and Team Magma are causing mayhem in the Hoenn region and must be stopped. We collect 8 badges, save the world from a massive disaster and try to beat the new Champion, Wallace! One of the best Pokémon speedgames in my opinion.
categories.name: Any% Glitchless

games.description: Emerald is the 5th and final game from the third generation of Pokémon games, being an upgrade of Ruby/Sapphire. It released in 2005, and many believe it to be the greatest entry in the Pokémon series. Filled with content like the Battle Frontier, it was ahead of its time. The speedrun is intriguing with RNG manipulation, Teleport with Abra and plenty of 95% accuracy moves giving plenty of excitement.
games.name: Pokémon Emerald

categories.description: DP Any% goes by quickly, which makes it very beginner friendly but also one where RNG manipulation is the key to saving time. We do a specific RNG manipulation in order to get a Chimchar with amazing stats and the best Hidden Power type, and also no wild encounters before we have access to repels!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Set in the Sinnoh region, Pokémon Diamond/Pearl were the first main series games in the franchise on released for Nintendo DS. The DS games have fantastic ways of doing RNG manipulation for very long periods of time, and can be blown apart with the powerful tweaking glitch. This makes the any% category one of the quickest Pokémon speedruns. I did this run at ESA Winter 2024 and have since clinched the World Record.
games.name: Pokémon Diamond/Pearl

categories.description: Heavy use of RNG manipulation and new routing has made this already excellent speedrun even more involved and interesting in recent years. Spawning a Rare Candy in a Hidden Grotto and 5IV wild encounters in Dust Clouds are among the highlights, as we tour Unova and decimate our enemy with Excadrill.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A sequel to Pokemon Black and White set in the Unova region. Filled with untimely critical hits, the heartbreaker, and a mole banished to the Over-Used tier in competitive for being too good. The Gen 5 games don't provide many useful glitches, but the snappy battle engine and ridiculously fast bike make this a busy Pokémon speedrun. It is a quirky game with many oddities, and a very special RNG mechanism that makes every DS console have its own set of seeds. A player has to create their own RNG.
games.name: Pokémon White 2

categories.description: The goal is to become the most wanted racer. All glitches are allowed, including the ability to skip bosses and manipulate the number of laps in circuit and knockout races. Chases also play a big role in the run since each boss requires a certain amount of bounty and milestones before facing them.
categories.name: Career Any% Glitches

games.description: Released in 2005, Need for Speed: Most Wanted takes us to the fictional city of Rockport where we must compete against 15 of the city's most elite street racers to become the most wanted. Between exciting street racing, thrilling police chases and a stunning soundtrack, no wonder why this is the best selling game in the Need for Speed series!
games.name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)

categories.description: Reach and solve the final puzzle without using any glitches. The ending may surprise you! (I’m not sorry)
categories.name: Glitchless

If I game over or the game crashes (which is rare, but can happen and is accounted for in the estimate) I will use passwords if needed to get back to where I was.
categories.name: Any% (Normal/Hard)

games.description: Maui Mallard in Cold Shadow (or Donald in Maui Mallard, as it was marketed in Europe) was first released on Genesis. The PC port is essentially a polished version of the Genesis game, and is a bit different when it comes to level design and gameplay compared to the SNES version which came later. It's an action platformer which has its fair share of clips, zips, and other skips, along with questionable hitboxes and jankiness in general.
games.name: Maui Mallard in Cold Shadow

categories.description: Start from the beginning of the game and get to the ending by any means possible. The route we use skips a lot of running (and fighting, most importantly) through the game. The only mandatory fights are the first boss and the last boss.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This is one of the Dark Souls clones of all time which has both clunky movement and Unreal Engine assets.
games.name: Dark SASI

categories.description: Beat the last bosses of both the DLC and the base game from a fresh savefile with the least amount of completion possible. This means we can't do/get anything that's optional and will have to beat the DLC + base game with only the starter weapon. Fortunately we can still play as Ms Chalice!
categories.name: DLC + Base Game Low%

categories.description: Beat the last boss of the DLC from a fresh save file with the least amount of completion possible. This means we can't do/get anything that's optional and will have to beat the DLC with only the starter weapon. Fortunately we can still play as Ms Chalice to make things a bit easier for us. :)
categories.name: DLC Low%

categories.description: Beat the last boss on Regular difficulty from a fresh savefile. Played on version 1.1 which is kind of a middle-ground between version 1.0 (which has a lot of crazy glitches) and 1.2+ (where a lot of stuff was patched), so we still have a moderate amount of glitches and exploits to work with.
categories.name: Any% (1.1+, Regular)

games.description: Cuphead is a 2D platformer with classic run 'n gun gameplay (think Contra, Metal Slug), and its visuals + audio is heavily inspired by 1930s cartoons which is done incredibly well. The DLC was released in 2022 and brought some new and interesting bosses for us to beat fast.
games.name: Cuphead

categories.description: As the category name says, you need to beat the game from start to finish in a new save file with no prior upgrades. The run is routed to start with the stages where we pick up the most useful upgrades/weapons as early as possible to speed up the movement and boss fights later on.
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: A retro-style action platformer with similarities to the Shinobi games and some Mega Man-esque game mechanics. There's a lot of focus on fluid movement and good platforming while also optimally using the powers/weapons you get from the bosses at the end of every stage. Oh, and the soundtrack slaps all the way through.
games.name: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider

categories.description: This category uses the Black Label mod - a mod that enables the game to emulate like the classic PS2 game. This adds efficiency to a few levels as exploits are present that cut down time on more tedious parts of the run like long-winded ship sections.
categories.name: Black Label Mod Any%

games.description: Ratchet and Clank Going Commando is a third person platformer-shooter originally developed for the PlayStation 2. This run features lots of camera tricks and unconventional uses of weapons that add a lot of efficient strategy to the run while still encapsulating the game's atmosphere.
games.name: Ratchet and Clank Going Commando

categories.description: We want to run back this segment from winter, we had a lot of fun and have gotten a lot of positive feedback. The segment was far from perfect, with several kinks to work out. So doing it again seems like the perfect way to end this sewer rave tourney saga. This one is for all the marbles.
categories.name: 8 Player tournament

games.description: Sewer rave is a cutesy exploration game created by indie dev Autumn Rain, the game has the player go through a sewer while talking to rats, doing quests for snakes, going to the movies, and having a knife fight with a possom. It has randomized doors that mean you are constantly on your feet about where you end up. The speedruns are very random and easy to get into, meaning it is also easy to explain to viewers.
games.name: Sewer Rave

categories.description: Coop redfall has changed a lot since it was last shown at ESA, with some patches, it has become a run that requires a lot more cooperation and splitting up. 2 player is an optimal amount for viewing. There is a glitch that allows one player to speed up their movement. Estimate is generous
categories.name: 2 Player Any%

games.description: Redfall is a bad video game released by the legendary Arkane studios, there's a lot of reasons why its bad, and we can get into it during our run, it has interesting implications for the rest of the video game industry. Also its about vampires. We could alternatively do NG+ instead of any% if a shorter run is wanted.
games.name: Redfall

categories.description: This is the co-op category, 4 players will play on the same console. The run is still the same but 4 players increases boss health, and overall chaos.
categories.name: Any% CO-OP 4 Player

games.description: 4 runners come together to defeat Freddy Krueger in a co-op run that only the most skilled can survive. In this run you collect bones, defeat bosses, and avoid obstacles the entire way as you see your health and lives slowly disappear, leading to a very intense set of final stages. This run is attempted in the practice area of almost all retro marathons and its ready for the main stage again, guaranteed to also bring some unintended hilarity due to the chaos 4 players brings.
games.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street

categories.description: This is the default speedrun category for Renegade, and is the one that has the most runs and is the most competitive. You complete each level to beat the game.
categories.name: Easy

games.description: Are you tough enough?!? Renegade is 4 stages of beat em up action, where enemies are thrown at you repeatedly, each more dangerous than the last. If you survive long enough, you get a chance to take on the final boss Sabu, who brings a gun to a fist fight. Defeat Sabu and save your partner. The term run and gun is heard a lot as a genre of game, well this is a run and punch the entire way.
games.name: Renegade

categories.description: This is the standard Any% category where each stage is completed to beat the game
categories.name: Beat the Game

games.description: Pizza Pop! is one of the later releases on the Famicom, and pits a friendly pizza delivery man against the world in his quest to get $10,000 to buy a diamond ring for his girlfriend. There is plenty of hazard pay as you need to climb buildings, escape a haunted house, a reimagining of the turbo tunnel, and fight many bosses along the way.
games.name: Pizza Pop!

categories.description: Two teams of 20 will compete in completing Ninja Gaiden 1 through 3 back to back. There are 20 acts total, and each player will play through 1 act. This game also has unlimited lives. game overs just bring you back to the start of the stage, so players can continue to push through their specific act
categories.name: Trilogy Relay Race (20 vs 20)

games.description: The Ninja Gaiden series is one of the most well known franchises in gaming. In years past ESA has seen Mario and Mega Man relay races, but its now time to step it up and pit two teams of 20 runners against each other in one of the most platforming intense series on the NES. To complete Ninja Gaiden 1 through 3 back to back, Apollo and friends will need determination to survive and the ability to adapt to the previous players' decisions. Ryu is about to have his moment in the sun.
games.name: Ninja Gaiden Trilogy Relay Race

categories.description: This is the default category in which each stage is completed in order. FYI my current vod was lost to the twitch purge, so feel free to deny if the linked video from the board is not good enough, which is a run that uses similar tricks and routing.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Chuck Rock is a caveman that goes on a hilarious quest to rescue his wife from the evil Gary Gritter. Chuck Rock attacks by using his belly and throwing large boulders in a game that was created to be a staple IP in the gaming industry. Although that did not quite pan out, Chuck Rock is a humourous platformer that has some of the most interesting animations and styles on the SNES.
games.name: Chuck Rock

categories.description: The above is a linked run of one of the runners who will be at ESA. This category is defeating the robot masters in each game, and then changing to the next game in the Mega Man series in order from 1-6. This is 6 stages in MM1 and then 8 stages in MM 2-6 with 46 players, each having one stage each.
categories.name: 46 Robot Masters

games.description: The Classic Mega Man games are back, except this time Apollo and Friends will be racing to defeat all of the Robot Masters from the NES Mega Man series. 46 players will guide Mega Man through platforming excellence in a stage relay.
games.name: Mega Man 1-6 46 Robot Masters Relay

categories.description: Beat the game by any means. This game does not have any major glitches as it requires collecting 75 flies to enter the final level
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Flame is the second game in the Spyro GBA trilogy. The primary goal is to get to collect 75 flies in order to stop Ripto. This game is almost meant to be a GBA retold version of the OG Spyro 2. Crush, Gulp, and Ripto are all bosses but all of the levels and collectibles are different. The run is very fast pace as we need 75 flies and the run being half an hr or lower
games.name: Spyro 2: Season of Flame

categories.description: Beat the game by any means. This game more follows a story and not really collecting items but there are major skips for all of the overworld zones and going straight to the boss towers of each zone. Tying this in to the infinite jump it is an enjoyable category to watch
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Shadow legacy is the last game in the main Spyro timeline. Spyro is trying to stop a dragon sorcerer guy and you traverse through an alternate shadow dimension map in addition to the main overworld map. Think like Zelda a link to the past style with two similar but slightly different overworld maps. The run uses one major trick. An infinite jump that is frame perfect. It is used constantly and is so demanding on the hands as you need quick inputs that runners wear a sock on their hand
games.name: Spyro: Shadow Legacy

categories.description: Beat the game by any means. This game does not have any major glitches as the game has a checklist on what is needed to enter the final area
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Rhynocs is the third game in the Spyro GBA trilogy. The primary goal is to get to Ripto's Chateau to stop him from conquering the lands and putting the professor into the lava. The run is entirely movement based as you need to collect a certain amount of gems and quest completions to enter the Chateau. This game is pretty open in terms of the level order so some of it can be tackled in various orders
games.name: Spyro: Attack of the Rhynocs

categories.description: An All Achievements run but cutting out all of the gambling achievements leaving us with 69 (nice) achievements to complete. Also cuts out a lot of downtime in the run making the whole run flow a lot smoother. Portions cut out in submission video: 4:05 to 27:35 AND 55:10 to 1:26:50
categories.name: All Achievements (No Gambling)

categories.description: A speedrun where the maximum amount of quests are completed without using the glitch 'dialogue storage'. There is a total of 96 quests to be completed in one playthrough without using this glitch and this run does it all. A speedrun where the maximum amount of quests are completed without using the
categories.name: Max Quests (No DS)

categories.description: Speedrun to complete the maximum amount of quests possible in the game (103). This speedrun let's runners complete two alternatives to quests that normally wouldn't be possible and the glitch that allows it to happen, dialogue storage, has never seen in a speedrunning event before
categories.name: Max Quests

games.description: Fallout: New Vegas is a spinoff of the popular fallout series and has grown to become one of the most popular in the series. With it's unique environment taking place in a post-apocalyptic Vegas, the Mojave Desert makes for a great place for glitches and exploits to be use to literally wizz through the air at lightning speed in true Bethesda spirit
games.name: Fallout: New Vegas

categories.description: A complete run around the entire island, collecting everything we can see as fast as possible! 100% completion requires the collection of all 47 golden balloons, all minigame keys, all golden trophies, both completed amulets, and beating both versions of the final boss, Wizpig! Large skips included.

Beat Wizpig in space while cutting as many corners as possible, in bounds and out of bounds! This run features the largest of skips, sequence breaking, combined with expert driving and routing. This run also features a very random trick which could lead to a handful of minutes saved.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: Collect the T.T. Amulet by winning all the minigames around the island! The wrong warp will not be used in this run, and is it's own sub-category. Tight driving, accompanied with expert routing to collect all the minigame keys and the complete T.T. Amulet!
categories.name: T.T. Amulet (No Wrong Warp)

games.description: Fast paced kart racing game featuring 3 unique vehicles (Car, Hovercraft and Plane) each with their own mechanics and handling techniques, bundled together in a bright and colorful adventure on Timber's Island.  Travel around the island to collect golden balloons to challenge each of the world's bosses to work towards taking down Wizpig. Expect to see tight racing lines, large skips and out of bounds movement, and maybe some randomness here and there to keep everyone on their toes!
games.name: Diddy Kong Racing

categories.description: The goal of the run is to collect 40 Gold Bolts, buy 10 Gold Weapons, and earn 30 Skill Points, which is shown in 3 check mark boxes after defeating the final boss. The run showcases a wide variety of tricks, insane movement and various strategies to collect everything throughout the game.
categories.name: All Checkmarks

games.description: Ratchet & Clank must save the galaxy by exploring various planets, retrieving infobots, and using powerful weaponry to defeat Chairman Drek and stop him from destroying the galaxies planets.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank (2002)

categories.description: The game starts in new game+ mode, which includes having the permanent fireball powerup and all abilities. The goal is to collect 40 orbs and then defeat ripto. Having access to the abilities from the start allows for a lot of unique routing options not normally available in the base game.
categories.name: 40 Orb NG+

categories.description: Starting the game from a fresh file and beating the final boss as quickly as possible. This category is a boss rush where you skip into each of the bosses without completing the requirements to access them. Includes a lot of cool out of bounds and tricks.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Spyro must travel to a variety of worlds to collect gems, orb and talismans in order to defeat Ripto and save Avalar.
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: This category is clearing the story on easy difficulty, from the first level, Time to Split, to the last level, Future Perfect. All cutscenes are skipped. In Game Time is used. Dying and checkpoint restarts do not invalidate.
categories.name: Any% (Easy)

games.description: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect (TSFP) is the third and final entry in the first person shooter franchise, developed by the same team as Goldeneye 007 and Perfect Dark. This run contains a decent amount of glitches abusing the 'uplink device', this games version of the gravity gun. Using objects throughout levels to skip cutscenes or straight up clip out of bounds. Some levels don't contain any of these glitches and instead will involve in depth level knowledge to get through them quick.
games.name: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect

categories.description: The game has an ingame counter for percentage. The 100% category has to visit every area in all 5 chapters. We meet people from 2 years before, complete missions, play different minigames and defeat optional bosses to bring peace to Spira. The noCC category is close to the expericence of the PS2.
categories.name: 100% No Creature Creator

categories.description: In this Category, the Use of the HD introduces Creature Capture System is allowed, making Combat a bit more boring but also alot easyer and faster

games.description: FFX-2 is the sequel to the FFX game, taking place 2 years after the defeat of Sin and bringing the Eternal Calm. Yuna gets to see a sphere of a person who looks like Tidus, and she decides to look for clues about his whereabouts. Joining her are Rikku and Paine as a group of Sphere Hunters. But dark events are waiting in the shadows, threatening the world of Spira again.
games.name: Final Fantasy X-2

categories.description: Trying to beat the Game as Fast as Possible, using everything the game gives us
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: Trying to beat the Game as Fast as Possible, using Edited Game Files to cut out most of the Cutsceenes, making the game a lot Shorter
categories.name: Any% CSR

games.description: A Story about Robin Williams Training Teenage Soldiers with the Sole Purpose of Killing his Ex Wife ...... or so i heard
games.name: Final Fantasy VIII

categories.description: Beating the game as fast as Possible without RNG Manipulation or Major Glitches
categories.name: Any% NMG No Manip

categories.description: The 100% Requirement is Opening All 171 Chests, as well as killing the 2 "Superbosses" (Gordovan Gades and Egg Dragon) befor ending the Game. The Rogue Like Ancient Cave in the middle of the run is very RNG heavy but ill prepare a backup save incase things go bad to make sure the estimate works out

A Combination of the Story 100% and the Ancient Cave Iris% Category (VoD of which not available since Twitch Highlight Limit and unable to upload to YT due to lot of copyright music in the background)
categories.name: True 100%

categories.description: A Combination of the Story 100% and the Ancient Cave Iris% Category (VoD of which not available since Twitch Highlight Limit and unable to upload to YT due to lot of copyright music in the background) with added 20$% ruleset
categories.name: True 100% 20$%

games.description: A World at the Brink of Doom as the Sinistrals are Rising with only our Hero Maxim beeing able to stop them. Peek SNES RPG, cool puzzles, great music.
games.name: Lufia 2 Rise of the Sinistrals

categories.description: You clear the game as fast as possible without using any warps that would allow you to skip worlds. You may collect warp whistles but not use them.
categories.name: Any% Warpless

categories.description: In 100% you play every numbered Level in every world including all Hammerbros, Forts and Plant Stages on the map.

games.description: Classic Jump and Run 2D Mario Game. You clear levels to advance in the 8 different worlds until you reach Bowser and defeat him to save the princess.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. 3

categories.description: In this Category we are only collecting 16 Stars as this is the Amount needed to Spawn Mips in the Basement. We use Mips to clip through the 30 Star door and thus we make it possible to go upstairs. There we need to perform 2 Backwards Longjumps to make it to the last Bowser Stage and save Peach.
categories.name: 16 Star

games.description: 3D Jump and Run Mario Game. You collect Stars in different Levels to unlock Bowser Stages until you defeat Bowser for the last time and save the Princess.
games.name: Super Mario 64

categories.description: In this Category you are not allowed to collect the Feather and thus using a Cape. You are also not allowed to enter the Star World so we can only take the shortest path through every world ro get to Bowser.
categories.name: No Cape, No Starworld

games.description: Classic Jump and Run 2D Mario Game. You clear levels to advance in the 7 different worlds until you reach Bowser and defeat him to save the princess.
games.name: Super Mario World

categories.description: Beat both stories of the game. Passwords are allowed.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Yu-Gi-Oh! turned into a top-down strategy game. The underrated sequel to the ever-popular Forbidden Memories, but a much different run with entirely different mechanics. With fascinating AI manipulations and a passwords system which allows for unique routing and a safe run (no long gauntlets like in FM, either!), the game has a lot of depth, tricky decision making, and a high skill ceiling. Would also like to promote that the game has a new category which skips the 5 minute intro!
games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Duelists of the Roses

categories.description: Beat the game on the hardest difficulty. Played on current patch to avoid old patch exclusive glitches as they trivialize the run a lot. In addition to the normal buffer for estimates, I added an extra 10 minutes to the estimate to account for hardware differences that may affect game performance.
categories.name: Any% (Hard)

games.description: Latest installment in the Digimon series. The game is very fast paced and feels very smooth to play, even more so in speedruns, which make it a good and balanced run to play/watch despite it being an RPG. Its balance between gameplay and cutscene feels just right, as well as its length for being an RPG speedrun. Its costumes and various language options also allow for some decent donation incentives.
games.name: Digimon Story: Time Stranger

categories.description: Obtains best ending by doing all the required quests in the game. Game speed is quite hardware dependent so estimate includes a bit of an extra buffer due to unknown hardware. New route compared to last year's showcase.
categories.name: True Ending (Hard)

games.description: RPG of the year 2024. Combines a lot of really great JRPG elements from both, the Persona series as well as the SMT series to create a phenomenal experience. While a lot of inspiration is drawn from Persona games, given it's made by the same creators, it doesn't suffer the exact same downtime issue for a speedrun setting, making it a great showcase overall.
games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio

categories.description: Standard Any% category, where you need to beat the game as fast as possible by any means possible. You get one bubble upgrade at the begging to bubble every enemy with one shot and hopefully keep it till the end without dying. Race against Lucha_Gym
categories.name: Any%

games.description: One of the wellknown Disney movies turned into decent game. You may think, why such a popular speedrun is almost never showcased ? Is it that hard and impossible to finish ? Well, quite the opposite, speedrunwise, game is quite boring with very simple stages without any significant tricks and it relies on RNG bossess, that's why it's submitted as race making it more interesting, where every fight the leading runner can be switching easily.
games.name: The Little Mermaid

categories.description: Standard Any% category, where you need to beat the game as fast as possible by any means possible.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: One of the standard tales, where young boy gets dragged into mysterious world and he needs to save it to get back to his own reality. Boss designes straight from horror are quite distinguishable. Slow paced gameplay with unqiue attack mechanic for platformer, where power meter gets empty after every attack and player needs to few seconds before being able to deliver fully charged attack again. Big sprites, big lag game as well, so lag reduction is important speedrun strat.
games.name: Astyanax

categories.description: Linus is probably most interesting from 4 of them. Various levels , which have interesting hazards like popping bubbles/balloons to climb on, clouds which suck you in, aligators swinging their tail to push you forward etc. You collect pieces of radio to call taxi from moon back to your planet
categories.name: Linus Spacehead

games.description: Codemasters set of unlicensed games for Nintendo. If you know their games, then you are already ready for some nice graphics, soundtrack and ... some questionable awkward mechanics with unforgivable one KO gameplay. Quattro Adventure cosnists of : Boomerang Kid, Super Robin Hood, Linus Spacehead and Treasure Island Dizzy.
games.name: Quattro Adventure

categories.description: Unique category to use only one specific weapon, which was probably never showcased during any marathon. Laser is second strongest weapon in the whole game right after spread. It completely changes feeling of the speedrun, turning it from fast mashing in rhythm to slow precisely calculated shots.
categories.name: Laser Only

games.description: Game everyone is familiar with probably. Two shirtless guys on the quest to destroy aliens and save the earth, Game has a decent amount of variety for its time, not only consisting of left to right platforming stages but also climbing stage and two base stages completely switching perspective. Random enemy spawns combined with one hit KOs will always keep you on your toes.
games.name: Contra

categories.description: This is a run completing every level in the game that allows for fastest possible routes/tricks due to the lesser concern of dying due to being on easy. There is still definitely a risk of death in the run at multiple moments though but levels (and as such the run as a whole) are very short
categories.name: Full Game Story Easy

categories.description: Get to show off all the challenges which are less serious, more fun/whacky mini-levels that includes things like: Surviving rounds of zombies, collecting bananas as a monkey, smashing glass with bricks, shooting clay monkeys with a minigun etc. Longer run compared to story so see more of the game
categories.name: Any% Challenges

games.description: This game is a fanmade remake of the OG TimeSplitters games that was developed for over a decade with the 1st game fully out. It's a classic fps in the style of Goldeneye64 and may look similar in gameplay to those runs. Runs consist of precise lines and cornering while killing/avoiding enemies as best as possible with the objective being to pick up an objective in each level and return it to an end goal. There are clips, tricks and tech we use to make this quicker though also tricker skillwise.
games.name: TimeSplitters Rewind

categories.description: Beat the final event of the year called "King Of The Year Grand Prix". Provides the most comprehensive and exciting Enthusia speedrunning experience, as you rise through the ranks, get increasingly more difficult races, and must obtain a prize car (through raffles!) to beat the final event.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Considered by many as a "Gran Turismo clone", Enthusia is an often overlooked simcade racing game that, thanks to its procedural event generation system, makes no playthrough ever the same. Its main career mode (especially in a speedrun setting!) often makes you face tough risk-versus-reward decisions that can drastically alter the course of the run, and you are actively rewarded for successfully taking on more difficult races, which makes it surprisingly good for a speedrun.
games.name: Enthusia: Professional Racing

categories.description: The Super Mario Odyssey Randomiser mod randomises a variety of things in the game. All the moons have swapped places, the amount of moons required to leave the kingdom are random, and all loading zones lead to a random sub-area. The goal for this run is to get to Moon kingdom and beat the game.
categories.name: Randomiser (any%)

games.description: Super Mario Odyssey is the newest entry of Marios saga of 3d games, where, shocker, peach gets kidnaped yet again and mario must save her from Bowsers grasp. Its most unique feature is Marios Companion Cappy, who can both aid his movement and take control of most enemies in the game. It offers a blend of movement and glitches no other game can offer. It is fast paced, while still allowing a more casual viewer to understand what is happening.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: The goal is to complete every level in the game, clearing both exits in levels that have 2 of them. Since this is coop, Mario and Luigi will take turns at playing levels, allowing us to split up between different parts of the world map without doing much backtracking.
categories.name: 96 Exit Coop

games.description: Mario and Luigi venture into the depths of Dinosaur Land joined by their trusty steed Yoshi. In this strange land, we find that there will be lots of cape movement tech, as well as a few whimsical glitches to spawn magical wings or invisible bosses here and there.
games.name: Super Mario World

categories.description:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tl76V7KLmy0
As discussed with Edenal, we will have something between 8-14 racers who will not be on screen and are racing either from the PC room or from at home. Commentary will be provided from one single feed with commentators on screen at all times.
categories.name: HEK GP

games.description:
High octane sim racing game. We can figure out the length of the race and make it shorter if thats necessary for the schedule. we would plan for a 50% race length, but could go down to 25%. also we could use the time of the submission to play the intro video and some other super cool highlights produced by our community, do an intro and a podium ceremony :D
needless to say, its going to be a spectacle
games.name: F1 25

categories.description: Its fast and fun and a good filler:)
categories.name: Any% no SLA

games.description: Short cute puzzle game
games.name: The Looker

categories.description: Achieve 100% completion on the game status screen by unlocking all cars and tracks. First you must get gold in all 10 licence tests, then you must finish 1st on all 10 tracks on Professional difficulty.

games.description: A 2002 spin-off title in the Gran Turismo series, released between GT3 and GT4. It was developed primarily to showcase various concept cars that were unveiled in motor shows across the world. It uses a similar physics engine to GT3, but includes many new cars and the return of Autumn Ring from the PS1 GTs. Tokyo-Geneva is the third Concept edition released, following 2001 Tokyo and 2002 Tokyo-Seoul. It was first released in Europe and then later released in Asia.
games.name: Gran Turismo Concept: 2002 Tokyo-Geneva

categories.description: The goal is simple: Reach the end. It's anything but easy to get there though. The original TR is very barebones in terms of mechanics and movement, requiring meticulous planning of sequences and step counts to make it look effortless. Glitches and skips are still aplenty, some unique to this entry.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: 8 years ago, young(er) Cadarev performed his first run at ESA, a run of Tomb Raider: Anniversary. That game, a remake of the original Tomb Raider, might have been the perfect opener and also foreshadowing for this personal story that could be finished at ESA Summer 2026. I have run 11 out of 12 mainline Tomb Raider games across many ESAs, with one last game waiting - the original Tomb Raider from 1996, the game that started it all 30 years ago, tank control and limited polygons counts included.
games.name: Tomb Raider (1996)

categories.description: The Act 5 Kitava speedrun completes the first 5 acts of the game as quickly as possible. This is a natural stopping point that is varied, fast paced and has a plethora of speed tech to talk about.
categories.name: A5 Kitava Templar

games.description:
A free-to-play, isometric online action RPG set in the dark fantasy world of Wraeclast, often considered a spiritual successor to Diablo II. The game has your character progress through procedurally generated zones, gear up with random drops, and customize with the massive passive skill tree. 

*The game is live service and is subject to patches, server downtime ect*
games.name: Path of Exile

categories.description: Complete the run as fast as possible wihtout any glitches. There isn't a 2p1c leaderboard so that's why the category name doesn't include it but we are doing the run 2 player 1 controller.
categories.name: any% glitchless

games.description: The game gives players a chance to guide a lost cat through a strange city while trying to get back to its friends. It is filled with a multitude of gaming mechanics such as puzzle solving, platforming, stealth and action-filled sequences. During the game you will encounter a group of robots who will help and guide you through the city, with a captivating story. During the run there will be many opportunities for donation reading or other messages.
games.name: Stray

categories.description: This is NG+ Speedrun to beat the games Main Quest as fast as possible. It will also be done on the games hardest difficulty known as Ultra Hard. Since its NG+ there will be a full loadout to use and make the fights look super fast. The run also features a good amount of interesting skips.
categories.name: NG+ Ultra Hard

games.description: Horizon Zero Dawn is the game that started it all for the Horizon Series. A apocalyptic game set 3000 years in the future, where our main character Aloy goes on a journey to find her mother which send her down a path on learning about the past so that she can save the future. The game features its iconic machines that are a big part of the gameplay and combat.
games.name: Horizon Zero Dawn

categories.description: Going through the game as fast as possible with some upgrades from the get-go (currently, there is only any% ng+ and 100% categories). There are some exploits (one quite egregious out of bounds skip) but the run is mainly about solid gameplay with some small skips here and there.
categories.name: Any% NG+

games.description:
Rochard is a side-scrolling action platformer published in 2011 with a scifi plot and aesthetic. The game centers around manipulating gravity which leads to some fun platforming. You have a gravity gun to throw boxes but also a laser blaster to shoot some baddies.

The game cannot be bought anymore due to a bankruptcy of the company but is on Steam and works on modern PCs.
games.name: Rochard

categories.description: The hardest challenge run ever conceived of in Jak and Daxter. All Flies Low Collectables brings together all of the hardest tricks in the game, tough movement through every level, and a wildly unconventional route that will confound even experienced players. Put this at 5am if you know ball.
categories.name: All Flies Low Collectables

games.description: A classic ps2 platformer known for its beautifully animated movement, vibrant colors, and generally being on vibes.
games.name: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy

categories.description: We actually play the game! The game has a ranking system that is largely ignored in every other category, but in this one we have to get a high enough score for the max rank on each stage. This increases the length and content of each level a LOT. Note: Submission is a relay of predetermined players
categories.name: All Max Ranks (NG+)

games.description: I mean... Street Boyz innit. PS2 budget japanese beat-em up where the worst part of the game is the combat. Good fun, ESA classic, BANGING music.
games.name: Street Boyz

opponentDtos.video: This is a video link trust

opponents.video: This is a video link trust

categories.description: Refunct AP randomizes all the platform clusters in the game and puts them along side all abilities such as wall jumps, ledge grabs and more into the AP item pool. Every time you step on a new platform, collect a cube or do other checks in the game 1 item is taken out of the pool.
categories.name: Archipelago Randomizer

games.description: Refunct is a first person platformer with super smooth movements and speedrun tech all the way through.
games.name: Refunct

categories.description: You start with every Key Item, Badge and HM in your inventory with the goal of beating the game as fast as possible. I managed to find a consistent route that beats this game in around 50 minutes. It involves finding a main consistently, preparing a moveset and enough money to survive the finale.
categories.name: Any% Start with All Key Items

games.description: Pokemon Red/Blue are generation 1 Pokemon games for GameBoy.
games.name: Pokemon Red/Blue

categories.description: 1 Star per player relay. Played as Luigi with a Switch 1 Pro Controller on Switch 2.
categories.name: 61 Player Relay

games.description: Super Mario Galaxy. Recently hot due to the movie.
games.name: Super Mario Galaxy

categories.description: Mario starts without abilities and without Nozzles. Every time he collects a Rainbow Shine a new ability is unlocked letting us further progress in the current seed. Additionally every loading zone is randomized similar to a Pokemon Map Randomizer.
categories.name: Randomizer

games.description: Super Mario Sunshine is the main series Mario game released on GameCube.
games.name: Super Mario Sunshine

categories.description:
Run starts upon selecting the campaign and ends upon the last mission complete screen
The fastest way to clear this game is also the hardest - because of a time defence mission later in the run, the time for which is cut in half on hard mode, we aim to clear the whole game on the hardest difficulty
categories.name: Any% (Allied Campaign)

games.description: Bow to Yuri! In the award-winning RTS expansion pack, Yuri reveals his plans to control the world through psychic domination - this run shows the best way to stop him! It demands intense micro and macro, very creative routing through all seven missions and their easter eggs, and the fastest way is on the hardest mode? We must race to contest insanely tight cycles and manage an intense amount of variable tasks all at once, offset with vintage Westwood charm. This promises to be a run to remember!
games.name: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 - Yuri's Revenge

categories.description: Run starts upon selecting the campaign and ends upon the last mission complete screen
categories.name: Any% (Soviet)

games.description: Bow to Yuri! The Soviets may have lost the war, but they can win the battle that counts as they hijack the time machine and get revenge on Yurii. This run shows RTS micro and macro in a tight time frame, with numerous audience-pleasing shortcuts and easter eggs to show how sharp knowledge and thorough routing can make a hard game look easy
games.name: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 - Yuri's Revenge

categories.description: What I'm looking to submit is something wildly ambitious: Completing Ratchets 1, 2, and 3 100% back-to-back-to-back. Links to the other 2 parts: https://youtu.be/fwnF2PKP-Dc?si=LH1i9GSsP4UpZG3r, https://youtu.be/5m-nHwFRpdE
categories.name: 100% Trifecta

games.description:
Ratchet 1 - The one that started it all. Wild momentum chains, PDA usage that lets you build speed in ways you could only dream of, ghost ratchet strategies, tech to abuse the camera's physical properties, POKITARU SKIP.
Ratchet 2 - Charge boots, baby! We can use the charge boots to do unreal movement tech from nothing. We can traverse whole levels with first person wall climbs, decoy clips, decoy proxies, turret clips.
Ratchet 3 - Imagine Ratchets 1 and 2, but this time in the perfect game.
games.name: Ratchet and Clanks 1, 2, and 3

categories.description:
Any% - Collect all 10 Notebooks and find the 4 exits before Raldi finds you and kills you.

This game is so insanely hard and luck-based that I'm giving myself a 90 minute estimate for a 7 minute game. I will make this worth the ride.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: You may know Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning but have you ever heard of Raldi's Crackhouse? You probably haven't. This game is completely insane. It's like if the guy who made Baldi's locked himself in a torture chamber in the Himalayas for about 3 weeks and did nothing but scroll TikTok. It's by far the most deranged game I've ever played, and I would love to spend 90 min on stage attempting to beat this work of insanity. I would love to do this immediately after the Clone Hero Concert
games.name: Raldi's Crackhouse

categories.description: In Clone Hero, we can play from thousands of different songs, so we'll put together a setlist between 60-90 minutes of all the classics. Songs people remember from games like Guitar Hero and Rock Band, as well as many others we think the crowd would love.
categories.name: ROCK CONCERT%

opponentDtos.video: This is a video link trust

opponents.video: This is a video link trust

games.description: I've assembled a team of 4 of the best plastic musicians the world has ever seen. Me, Jarvis9999, WarDrums_, and SixRockFire. The four of us would go on stage for 60-90 minutes and put on a rock concert through the game Clone Hero. We'd create our own setlist, perform it for a live audience, and melt faces. Check my video link for more details.
games.name: Clone Hero Rock Concert

categories.description: As already mentioned, dodgeball is the best gamemode! Go through 3 tournements of dodgeball, 3 matches each, and a final boss in order to get a bunch of crystals! The game is heavily RNG based, thus the safe estimate, but a ton of fun to both do and watch!
categories.name: Dodgeball (2 on 2)

games.description: Mario Sports Mix is a sports party game developed by square enix and released on the wii. The game has 4 different sports to play, basketball, hockey, volleyball, and dodgeball (the objectively best one). A good fun time all around!
games.name: Mario Sports Mix

categories.description: Get all the achievements in the game as quickly as possible. We start with a normal any% run to get the speedrunner achievement, then go wild by collecting everything, finding all the secrets, and ending the run by setting free an eldritch horror! Good times for all!
categories.name: All Achievements

games.description: Cariamara is a short and sweet horror game with point & click elements. The games any% run can be done in less than 4 minutes making it very quite short! This is of course, not what i'll be submitting, but is worth noting. It's spooky, it's moody, and it has some neat tech and out of bounds shenanigans to beat it as fast as possible
games.name: Carimara: Beneath The Forlore Limb

categories.description: The full game start to finish as fast as possible. The restricted refers to the accessibility features which allows you to skip combat through intended means. BORING! we're skipping them with out of bounds instead!
categories.name: Any% Restricted

categories.description: Chapters 6 through 11 is the most fun and interesting stretch of the game. With tricks, out of bounds, and and tech near enough every second, it's an interesting watch while cutting out a lot of the fluff and less interesting parts.
categories.name: Chapter 6-11 Showcase

games.description: South of midnight is an action adventure game developed by Compulsion games and released in 2025. The follows hazel who has to find her Ma' and unravel a magical mystery and the deep south of the United States. While the game has a large focus on combat, the speedrun does not. By using huge out of bounds, and lots of interesting tech, we can skip nearly all the combat in the game and get through the game very quickly. out of the 14 chapters, only 3 lack major skips. Lots of things happening!
games.name: South of Midnight

categories.description: Beat all 4 worlds and the two final bosses as quickly as possible. For the sake of marathon safety, i'll be allowing the use of checkpoints at the start of each world just in case i manage to die. Otherwise we just hope luck is on our side with bosses and upgrades!
categories.name: Any% Checkpoints Allowed

games.description: Dashing fire is a neat little rogue-lite where you dash between planets with the ultimate goal of becoming the new sun! It's important to pay attention so you don't lose your health, while also playing fast enough for a good time!
games.name: Dashing fire

categories.description: There are 3 possible difficulties: Dracky, Dragon and Draconian. Dragon is the normal difficulty, that the game was balanced for. If things go very wrong we can still move to Dracky during the run to not ruin the estimate. Some bosses are very hard and because of the seeds our stats are inconsistent
categories.name: any% (Dragon difficulty)

games.description: Remake of one of the first JRPG ever, DQ1 HD-2D is totally modernized, giving a lot of tools and ressources to the player to complete the game. Same as the original version, we are still alone, but we can fight more than one enemy at the same time. The world is quite open which allows us to get strong equipments and abilities very early in the run
games.name: Dragon Quest I HD-2D Remake

categories.description: In this run we have a Thief as our damage dealer. The XP management is very important so he learns Padfoot as early as possible to reduce the encounter rate. Then he will learn Persecutter for the 2nd half of the run, which deals 600% dmg to sleeping enemies
categories.name: any%

games.description: First HD-2D remake of the Erdrick trilogy, this game introduces new bosses and a new class from the original version. Although it got patched last year to nerf this new class, which really reduced the possiblity of multiple routes. The only viable route now uses the fact that bosses are weak to sleep for the first turns of the battle, which makes boss battle very fast but quite dangerous
games.name: Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake

categories.description: Category simply consists of completing the game normally. To unlock the story triggers you need to collect treasures to increase your vault value, which will also unlock boss fights that gives you hints to find the 7 seven stones, supreme and mandatory treasures to unlock the final part of the story
categories.name: any%

games.description:
A very particular Dragon Quest game ! In this spin-off, no turn based battle, it is in real time!
