Your main weapon is a slingshot, which can throw a ton of different pellets to adapt on the different weaknesses of the enemies. You can also scout monsters so they join your journey and help you to find treasures! 
The only downside about this run is the RNG aspect : everything about the treasures is random, same for the dungeons, and the monster behaviour is very inconsistant.
games.name: Dragon Quest Treasures

categories.description:
This run uses a lot of RNG manipulations. Early ones are almost mandatory so our stats matched with the mid game manips. I will prepare backups if I break long manips (metal slimes for instance)
Mid and late game can be manipless but would take longer so I'm taking this into account for the estimate
categories.name: any%

games.description:
Originally released in 1992, DQ5 is the first game which features monster scouting. Since the game also has playable characters, the player can choose who to play. Moreover, DQ5 is known for its great story and even got its own movie (Dragon Quest Your Story)
You see your Hero growing through different generations (child, young adult, father) while going through rough patches
games.name: Dragon Quest V

categories.description: The run abuses of the synthesis to unlock strong monsters and particularly strong spells to snowball and stomp the mid game, after a difficult early game. The game gifts a few bonus balls at the very beginning that we can use to increase our XP gains, thanks to this we can rush without farming a lot
categories.name: any%

games.description: After the success of Dragon Quest Monster Joker 1 & 2 outside japan (3 only came out in jp), Dragon Quest Monsters 3 is the most recent Monster spin-off released around the world! It tells the story of Psaro, the vilain of Dragon Quest IV, who became a monster wrangler to rule on Nadiria. In this game you will control up to 4 monsters in battle, that you can either scout in different biomes or synthesis together to create even more powerful monsters. It has Cutscene skip & fast battle animations
games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters 3

categories.description: Any% and Best Ending both start with a level grind and end with the final bosses. I prefer Best Ending because it shows a huge part of the game in between, balancing out the time spent grinding. It took over 3 hours at first before I optimized. There is a ton of rng, reflected in the estimate.
categories.name: Best Ending

games.description: An action rpg, similar to Diablo 2. Time stops when you do, like in Superhot. You also don't have any mana - spells drain your HP. The game was developed by my brother which inspired me to master it. It starts with 20-30 minutes of level grinding split into 3 sections, which might sound like a lot but I reach end game strength and unlock teleport, allowing me to fly through the rest of the world at great pace. Unfortunately I don't have a video with explanations, though I would explain it live.
games.name: Fates of Ort

categories.description: Any% beats every level. 100% requires the optional collectibles which in my opinion just slows the pace and introduces some inconsistencies, so I'll save that for some other time.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Unravel is a puzzle platformer with jank physics that can be abused using various yarn related mechanics. There are enough glitches to keep things interesting and each of the 11 levels have at least some skip. Unravel has the reputation of being a bit of a cutesy game, among people who have not played it, but the speedrun has a lot of depth that I hope to show off. It's a visually stunning, easy to follow run. I have had the WR for at least six years but have yet to show it at a major marathon.
games.name: Unravel

categories.description: Any% Challenging is the vanilla category as those are the default settings when you launch the game. It only shows off a fraction of the game as it is split into different modes, perhaps in the future I will submit a longer category.
categories.name: Any% Challenging

games.description: Ynglet is one of Nifflas' newer games. It's described as a 2D platformer seen from above. Basically while inside the bubbles you have free control, while outside you are at the mercy of your momentum and the force of gravity. To me it's a masterpiece of art and gameplay that anyone who sees will want to play, but even if that is exaggerated, the run is very visually interesting and unique, and should captivate the audience. Note: level 1 is much slower than the rest of the run.
games.name: Ynglet

categories.description: The Tag Force games feature many potential tag partners, but in this game, the optimal choice is Misty Tredwell, thanks to some synergy between her deck and the player's starter deck, relatively tolerable opponents, and a unique strategy to beat the final duel of her story.
categories.name: Any% (Misty)

games.description: Based on the 2008 series of the anime, this children's card game video game does not feature any motorcycles but gameplay a lot closer to the real card game than games in the franchise previously shown at ESA. The gimmick of the Tag Force series is tag duels, which means that the player not only has to worry about their opponents, but also their cpu tag partner's incompetence in up to four duels per run.
games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Tag Force 4

categories.description: SotN randomizer has almost 40 presets to offer as well as option to cook your own thing. Every preset has some sort of quirk like being focused on certain transformation, relying on magic mirror to switch between castles or having to farm Dracula relics as enemy drops.
categories.name: Randomizer

games.description: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night is the foundational Metroidvania title, celebrated by the speedrunning community for its immense freedom of movement and non-linear level design. The run is defined by an incredibly high skill ceiling, utilizing advanced movement tech and game breaking glitches
games.name: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night

categories.description: Requiem offers a version of SotN to play on PS4. While the game is mostly the same from casual perspective, it offers a completely different speedrun. This version functions as a hybrid of the PSX international version and the original Japanese release, featuring its own distinct set of glitches.
categories.name: Any% Requiem / DXC PAL

games.description: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night is the foundational Metroidvania title, celebrated by the speedrunning community for its immense freedom of movement and non-linear level design. The run is defined by an incredibly high skill ceiling, utilizing advanced movement tech and game breaking glitches
games.name: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night

categories.description: Low% Souls is a category that forces the runner to complete Dawn of Sorrow while acquiring the absolute minimum number of souls required to beat the game.
categories.name: Low% Souls

games.description: Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow provides a high-octane speedrun experience focused on the game's unique Soul System and fast, precise combat. Runners must carefully balance RNG and resource management while utilizing advanced movement techniques, such as backdash canceling and usage of limited damage options
games.name: Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow

categories.description: You start from a fresh game and complete the run by beating Mysterio. 1 player uses two controllers to access glitches that allow for skipping many arenas. Run involves fight routing, skips of levels and enemies, as well as pivoting coop characters to complete certain stages faster.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This is a 3D beat em up style Spiderman game from the late 2000s based heavily off the beloved Raimi verse and other comic books. Spiderman has to work (in coop modes) to find the mastermind behind a symbiote army while recruiting enemies and allies (friends and foes...). Nick tasks Spiderman to travel the world and find out where this army is coming from. This has a quirky story with memorable characters from all over Spiderman's rogues gallery.
games.name: Spiderman Friend or Foe

categories.description: Heavy use of RNG manipulation and new routing has made this already excellent speedrun even more involved and interesting in recent years. Some strategies involve manipulating hidden grottoes, some involve using dust clouds to spawn desirable encounters. Game ends at becoming Champion.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The sequels to Pokemon Black/White set in the Unova region. This run shows the famous route of using Drilbur and Excadrill as the clear choices to beat the game fast. While there aren't many glitches, there are interesting strategies involving RNG manipulation that is different for each runners console, which makes a novel and unique experience to watch and do runs. The story takes centre stage and the pokémon battles are risky but just right.
games.name: Pokémon White 2 - Nintendo DS

categories.description: Any% Features 1 glitch (which is walking through a rock) and one of the most unique strategies in all of pokemon, Plasma Skip (using dust clouds to skip trainers.) You RNG manip a Lillipup to use in this run and use it for the rest of the game, a big contrast to the old Emboar route.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The 5th gen of Pokémon (and the best one). These games are full of live and are the first time Game Freak massively focused on a story. All the characters are brilliantly written and in an amazing 2D art style. Features turn based combat and RNG manipulation to achieve the fastest times like many other pokemon entries.
games.name: Pokémon Black

categories.description: A Race between two routes of Any%, Throné and Castti DPS. Any% is completing the entire game (all 8 stories, all 4 side stories) then completing the final boss Vide before the credits. This is a glitchless category and showcases multiple strategies to quickly complete bosses which differs per route.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Octopath 2 is a JRPG and sequel which vastly improves upon the original game. It features 8 core travelers, allowing you to build a team of up to 4 at any given point, to complete stories and defeat bosses and encounters in a turn based format. The game uses a 'Break & Boost' battle style, beautiful visuals and a great OST. 
(Race with March/Linewashere - if accepted pls reach out about resolutions!)
games.name: Octopath Traveler II

categories.description: The glitched route uses Chimchar and RNG manipulation for most of the run. You play until the bike, after you beat Jupiter. Once you get the bike, you perform a glitch called Tweaking to instantly complete the game, a fun ending especially if it hasn't been seen before by viewers!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Game Freaks first Pokémon games on the DS. Features turn based combat as is standard for Pokemon. The fastest times use RNG manipulation to achieve encounterless runs and the ideal starter stats. These games are captivating and hold many good memories for viewers (myself included - gen 4 was my first!). This is also one of the shortest Pokémon runs, making it inviting for new runners and a great example to showcase the community.
games.name: Pokémon Diamond

categories.description: Beating pokemon platinum without glitches or RNG manipulation. There are a few routes that are fast for this run, but I will likely use the most consistent for a marathon setting, which is using chimchar for start of the run, then trading a machop for an abra and using kadabra for the rest.
categories.name: Any% Glitchless Manipless

games.description: Pokemon game set in the great region of sinnoh.
games.name: Pokémon Platinum

categories.description: 14 Talisman collects the end of level item from the levels of the first two homeworlds in order to fight Gulp, the second boss, as "intended". Skipping into Ripto is allowed
categories.name: 14 Talisman

categories.description: Beat up that short guy asap
categories.name: any%

games.description: Spyro: Ripto's Rage is a collectathon platformer with the goal of beating up this short king named Ripto.
games.name: Spyro: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: After creating a character and a small prep phase, the majority of the run is using the game's various mounts to traverse the entire continent. Items from the account and informational overlays are allowed.
categories.name: World Completition

games.description: Guild Wars 2 (2012) is an MMORPG with a huge world to interact with and explore. It features a wide variety of races, cultures, and environments, while also giving the player skills and mounts with varied abilities to traverse that world. The ultimate prize rewarding that exploration (at least on launch 14 years ago) is the Gift of Exploration, awarded to characters that explore each of the 6 cities and 25 zones. This run aims to earn a gift of exploration as fast as possible.
games.name: Guild Wars 2

categories.description: To beat the game, you normally have to make use of Cappy to capture enemies and use their abilities. In minimum captures, we make use of skips in order to get moons and progressing through the game skipping those captures. The minimum number of captures in 2 Player mode in 1.4.1 version is 4
categories.name: Minimum Captures Any% (2P, 1.4.1)

games.description: Super Mario Odyssey is a single player game from 2017 in which you have to beat all the kingdoms with the required moons (main collectibles) to finally beat the moon kingdom's escape section and exit the wire to beat the game. It is a very fast-paced and easy to follow speedrun with bright colors and cool animations.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: This is a new game run where you are required to collect 30 bottles across the 8 episodes of the game and open the individual vaults in each episode to unlock their hidden gadgets. Cheats and glitches are allowed to complete the run as fast as possible and the runs ends after defeating Clock-la.
categories.name: All Vaults w/ cheats

games.description: The 2nd title in the Sly Series where the series was established as a stealth action platformer where you get to play as all members of the Cooper Gang.  The movement tech is the staple of the run since large sequence breaks are not possible in the game due to the chained trigger system that persisted into the later games. Looting guards and overworld treasures are required to purchase necessary gadgets to save the most time with each Cooper gang member.
games.name: Sly 2: Band of Thieves

categories.description: Complete the episode as quickly as possible using tricks and glitches to complete all jobs in the episode and the ending operation, timing ends upon defeating the episode boss.
categories.name: Episode 3 Any%

categories.description: Complete the episode as quickly as possible using tricks and glitches to complete all jobs in the episode and the ending operation, timing ends upon defeating the episode boss.
categories.name: Episode 4 Any%

categories.description: Complete both episodes as quickly as possible in chronological order using tricks and glitches, timing ends upon defeating the Episode 4 boss.
categories.name: Episode 3+4

games.description: The 4th title in the Sly Cooper series where the gang has to go back in time to save respective Cooper ancestors across history. The movement is where it is at but with the added ability to skip cinematics to reduce time spent watching pesky cutscenes. The chained trigger system is still in effect here so no major sequence breaks are possible in runs of this game.
games.name: Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time

categories.description: Just get to the end :D
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Halo 14 – Definitive Edition is an expert-level Kaizo hack for Super Mario World.

Featuring custom music and innovative mechanics never seen before in other hacks, the game delivers a fresh and intense Kaizo experience. The hack features 23 exits and is mostly linear in its progression. It even includes a unique level where you must record your inputs blindly and then play them back, relying on accuracy and timing to successfully clear the stage.
games.name: Super Mario World Kaizo - Halo 14 - Definitive Edition

categories.description: Match Play: Two players go head-to-head on all main game levels on the Agent difficulty. The best in-game time on a level is awarded a point. In the event of a tie, the point carries over until a player bests the other. Most points win. A competitive exhibition between two of the game's top players!
categories.name: Match Play Exhibition

games.description: GoldenEye 007 has a rich speedrunning history, with a community that stretches back to the late 90s. Speedruns focus mostly on individual level (IL) records, where tight movement, great aim and lag management are key. While full-game runs are competitive, and any% runs/races have taken place at events in the past, the premier competitive format within the community in recent years is that of Match Play, a head-to-head format, showcasing both IL WR and ad hoc strategies! Co-commentator: ThaRixer.
games.name: GoldenEye 007

categories.description: This fast-paced run uses RNG manipulation for our best chance of survi- I mean, great stats in order to get through the run as quickly as possible. The tools available for finding RNG seeds has made manips very rewarding to discover and execute in runs. Will still get owned by a 12/16 somewhere.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Two years after Pokemon Black and White, a young trainer begins their fast-paced, chaotic Pokemon journey through the Unova region. Along their journey, they will encounter untimely critical hits, the heartbreaker, and a mole banished to the Over-Used tier in competitive for being too good. Unfortunately the Gen 5 games don't provide many useful glitches but the run itself is amazing and many places are unique !
games.name: Pokémon White 2

categories.description: Any% Glitchless aims to become the Champion. Team Aqua and Team Magma are causing mayhem in the Hoenn region and must be stopped. We collect 8 badges, save the world from a massive disaster and try to beat the new Champion, Wallace! One of the best Pokémon speedgames in my opinion.
categories.name: Any% Glitchless

games.description: Emerald is the 5th and final game from the third generation of Pokémon games, being an upgrade of Ruby/Sapphire. It released in 2005, and many believe it to be the greatest entry in the Pokémon series. Filled with content like the Battle Frontier, it was ahead of its time. The speedrun is intriguing with RNG manipulation, Teleport with Abra and plenty of 95% accuracy moves giving plenty of excitement.
games.name: Pokémon Emerald

categories.description:
This category utilizes the "Speedrun Mod" made for the game, cutting out almost all cutscenes totaling to around 5:30 hours, meaning there's more focus on the actual gameplay.
This category also heavily utilizes RNG-manipulation to get favorable item drops, damage rolls and enemy encounters.
categories.name: Cutscene Remover

games.description:
Final Fantasy X is one of the most beloved games from the PS2 and has a long and storied speedrun scene.
The game is a classical JRPG focusing on building your team, leveling up, equipment and getting stronger, which in a speedrun lends itself to becoming less mechanically complex than something like a platformer, however the ways we use the games systems in a speedrun is very fascinating.
games.name: Final Fantasy X

categories.description: Exploration bingo is where you start with only 2 goals on a 5x5 board of goals revealed, in order to reveal new goals you have to complete the ones you can see. Blackout means we will complete the entire board of goals. This will use heavy cooperation and planning between us as to who's doing what.
categories.name: Co-op exploration blackout bingo

games.description: Ocarina of Time is a Nintendo all-time classic known by many, showcasing the Hero of Time: Link as he embarks to save The Kingdom of Hyrule. This becomes an epic quest where you travel all over Hyrule as both a child and an adult doing sidequests, conquering dungeons and saving the land, however in the hands of speedrunners who know every little intricacy of the game this can be done incredibly fast with tons of flashy and interesting techniques.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of time

categories.description: Chargeless Any% is a challenge run where Spyro's charging movement mechanic is disallowed, limiting the player from many enemies and collectables that would normally be necessary to complete the game. Instead the runner must use proxies, wallglides, and other unusual tricks to defeat Gnasty Gnorc.
categories.name: Chargeless Any%

games.description: Spyro the Dragon is a collect-a-thon 3D platformer from the 90s. It follows Spyro as he frees his dragon elders and tracks down the fanal boss, Gnasty Gnorc. The game was hailed for its level of detail engine that allowed for wide open landscapes for its players to explore. Speedrunners are drawn to it for its tight and fluid movement as well as its diverse exploits.
games.name: Spyro the Dragon

categories.description: This run collects all 25 secrets on the map "Leptis Magna", one of the largest and most impressive maps of the mod. It features several sequence breaks and flashy explosive boosts to collect the secrets very much out of the intended order.
categories.name: "Leptis Magna" - All Secrets

games.description: Probably the best and grandest scale Quake mod out there. New maps, monsters and items all bundled up in such a tasteful way to build a fantastic atmosphere. Created by a large community team of level designers, artists and coders, so would be a great showcase for the still thriving Quake mapping community. Especially since the speedruns still feature the fast-paced gameplay with bunnyhopping and damage boosting that Quake is so famous for.
games.name: Quake: Arcane Dimensions

categories.description: NG+ plays through the - technically more difficult - + mission pack developed by TerranovaTeam as part of Colobot: Gold Edition, the NG part of the category allows the use of pre-written programs and hidden commands though, so every mission is trivial to complete.
categories.name: NG+

categories.description: This is the NG+ ruleset - allowing the use of pre-written programs and hidden instructions, but running the main Colobot campaign instead of the + mission pack, which contains multiple levels that require skills in early 2000s parkour using tank controls and a jetpack.
categories.name: NG+ (Main Campaign)

games.description: Colobot is the action-adventure spin on the CeeBot educational programming game. Earth is no longer fit for human habitation, and the automated missions that were launched into the stars to find a replacement homeworld failed for some reason, so a manned mission is sent out to follow in their footsteps, to figure out what went wrong, and to give humanity a path to their new homeworld - Terra Nova.
games.name: Colobot

categories.description: The Firerod category uses all the power of the Firerod item to break the game in every conceivable way, be it sequence breaks, out of bound movement, parallel universes movement, and even editing the level during gameplay in often very funny ways.
categories.name: Firerod%

categories.description: Firerod Reverse Element Order pushes the Firerod run to its absolute conceptual limit by using every bizarre sequence break available in the game in order to create the most unexpected way you can beat this Zelda game.
categories.name: Firerod Reverse Element Order

games.description: Minish Cap is considered the last "retro" 2D Zelda game, ending an era of beautiful pixel art. The speedrun is very knowledge and tech intensive, overflowing with a lot of odd-looking glitches, out of bound movement of every kind, and RNG manipulations which require very solid execution.
games.name: Zelda : The Minish Cap

categories.description: This category, absent from DSR's own speedrun leaderboard, opposes the very concept of the game. You cannot deal damage to enemies or even bosses. We shall then draw into the deepest ressources available to us in order to defeat bosses without even lifting a finger.
categories.name: Pacifist%

games.description: Dark Souls Remastered, even among other Souls games, is a title including an unending palette of glitches, sequence breaks and other creative ways to exploit the game's structure. Coupled with a beautiful interconnected map these factors make this RPG into a very modular game, reinvented through each and every challenge run you can offer it.
games.name: Dark Souls Remastered

categories.description: A 100% run includes collecting all weapons, all equipment, rescuing all prisoners and defeating all bosses
categories.name: Metal Gear MSX 100%

games.description: Taking it back to the OG Metal Gear! A 100% run for extra challenge, collecting all weapons, all equipment, rescuing all prisoners and defeating all bosses!
games.name: Metal Gear

categories.description: In this category you need to collect any 60 shines before Corona Mountain unlocks. You then beat Bowser (assuming you've found the required Ground Pound, Spray Nozzle, and Rocket Nozzle)
categories.name: 60 Shines

games.description:
A romhack of Super Mario Sunshine where all loading zones are randomized, as well as Mario's moveset being inaccessible until unlocked by collecting rainbow shines. The video submission is highly unoptimized due to lack of time with the newest version of the rando. I will improve the estimate before the event, though I might lower the requirement to 50 shines to ensure the run is under 2 hours. (Run done on Wii with HDMI) 
Example Martahon commentary: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KDjBeyWZr08
games.name: Super Mario Sunshine Randomizer

categories.description: The zipless category is my all time favourite as it shows of the best this game has to offer. This category allows for a great showcase of all the amazing glitches, skips and tricks the community has found over the years. I also did this in a race 10 years ago for my first ESA. Anniversary special!
categories.name: Any% Zipless

games.description: Timeless 3d platformer with interesting glitches and smooth gameplay makes for easy watching
games.name: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time

categories.description: The category has massively been improved since I've last shown it off at an event, where it became a lot shorter by skipping the biggest levels. A relaxing run to watch with old game vibes and interesting glitches
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Dreamcast port of Prince of Persia 3D with major improvements to movement speed and additional glitches
games.name: Prince of Persia: Arabian Nights

categories.description: Any% Involves collecting 170 Green stars and completing the final stage in World Bowser (World 8). It includes many level breaking skips and exciting movement that is captivating and intriguing. Timing Starts on the character select screen and ends once the final flagpole has been raised.
categories.name: 3D World any%

games.description: Super Mario 3D World is an exciting speed game filled with fast paced movement and massive skips. Released for the Switch in 2021 it has fostered a dedicated and active speedrunning scene aiming to make Luigi/Toad/Peach beat the game in as little time as possible. With 12 unique worlds to explore it offers a dynamic speedrunnning expereince for those who play and enjoy the game
games.name: Super Mario 3D World + Bowsers Fury

categories.description: Typical Any%, beat all the levels in the game.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Jak the Chicken is a mod for Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy. It takes all the levels from the video game Mort the Chicken which was already shown at the event. Basically this is Mort the Chicken but with Jak & Daxter movement and mechanics. Even though my time isn't that good because I haven't done many runs of this game, I promise to improve that time if this run gets accepted.
games.name: Jak the Chicken

categories.description: Reach Ending A from the fresh file.
categories.name: A Ending

games.description: First and less known Nier game. This game combines various JRPG elements with action combat. The game features some nice movement along with cool combat sections, skips and routing which revolves around money RNG.
games.name: Nier

categories.description: NG+ is the shortest category. We got all 28 gold bolts which gives as certain advantages and also max upgraded weapons which makes combat easy. A category that's short but shows off a lot of things this game can do.
categories.name: NG+

games.description: Remake/Reimagining of the original name, you name it. If you have ever seen the run of the original, I'll let you know that the speedrun of this game is completely different. It doesn't focus as much on movement and more so about maneuvering OOB or doing some insane glitches like wrong warping.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank PS4

categories.description: Finish the game. No glitches allowed meaning this run is pure movement optimizations. Due to glitches not being allowed, the skips in this category can get really creative and unique compared to other categories.
categories.name: Any% No Major Glitches

games.description: Third game of the Sands trilogy. Prince of Persia games are known for their sick platforming mechanics which were ahead of the time when the games released. The run can vary heavily depending on a category. Categories are split depending on the glitches allowed for said category. I have learned tons of skips and small optimizations which are done only in TAS and have never been done in RTA setting.
games.name: Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones

categories.description: NG+ gives us max upgraded Logan who is capable of ripping through everything with relative ease.
categories.name: NG+

games.description: The game made after the movie of the same name. Wolverine game in the series that's liked by many due to it's brutal hack & slash combat. In speedrun we skip quite a lot of things due to infinite jumping being possible in this game.
games.name: X-Men Origins Wolverine

categories.description: Collect every single ability in the game and then fight the final boss. Going OOB is banned. Run is done on the most recent patch. I will learn the most up to date route for this which is quite different to what I have shown back at Summer 24.
categories.name: All Abilities No OOB Map Patch

games.description: Indie Metroidvania platformer that released in 2023. This game is heavily movement based with usage of various abilities we collect throughout the run. I have done a run of this game at Summer 24 and it was a complete disaster so I want to try again and give this run justice.
games.name: Pseudoregalia

categories.description: A Mega Man 3 Any% Buster Only run is a high-skill, endurance-driven challenge that restricts the player to using only Mega Man’s default arm cannon ("lemons") for the entire game, banning the use of Robot Master weapons to damage bosses. This is arguably one of the hardest BO runs in the series.
categories.name: any% (buster only)

games.description: Mega Man 3 (1990) is a seminal 2D action-platformer for the NES, widely regarded as one of the best and most challenging entries in the classic series. The game follows Mega Man on a quest to stop his reformed nemesis, Dr. Wily, from misusing a new peacekeeping robot, Gamma, after the eight robot masters used to gather its energy components go rogue.
games.name: Mega Man 3

categories.description: Unlike Type-A, Type-B features bosses at rounds 9, 19, 29, 39, and 49. Instead of simply clearing all monsters to finish the round, you must damage the boss by matching bombs and monsters directly next to them.
categories.name: 50 levels (type-B)

games.description: Wario's Woods is a unique, fast-paced action-puzzle game released by Nintendo in 1994 for the NES and SNES, notable for being the last officially licensed game for the NES in North America. Unlike most games in the series, it stars Toad rather than Mario, who must navigate a single-screen, vertical puzzle layout to defeat Wario and his minions.
games.name: Wario's Woods

categories.description: A Mega Man 4 Any% Buster Only run is a high-speed, technical challenge that restricts the player to using only Mega Man’s base arm cannon to complete the entire game. This category eliminates the use of special boss weapons, forcing the runner to rely almost entirely on standard shots and the newly
categories.name: any% (buster only)

games.description: Released in 1991 for the NES, Mega Man 4 is a direct continuation of the classic 2D action-platforming formula, widely recognized for introducing the charge-shot mechanic to the series. The game follows Mega Man as he investigates a new threat, the mysterious Dr. Cossack, who has sent eight new Robot Masters to destroy him.
games.name: Mega Man 4

categories.description: The goal of this run is to collect of the available Steam Achievements. It uses a plethora of glitches to duplicate certain materials and other items which otherwise need to be farmed for long hours. Additionally, by enabling the community-created Dropmod, we have no RNG in weapon drops!
categories.name: All Achievements (Dropmod)

games.description: It's Dark Souls. Started this whole Souls shenanigan, it's pretty cool. Good tech in speedruns as well.
games.name: Dark Souls: Remastered

categories.description: The goal is to defeat the final bosses of the Base Game as well as the DLC. It creates a fun dynamic of swapping between the two areas in hopes to obtain loot and become more powerful. Some cool skips are included despite it being a Glitchless run. Glitchless also means fighting the bosses, yay!
categories.name: Two Gods Glitchless

games.description: Elden Ring as you know it.
games.name: Elden Ring
